detail.title: Tariff Cuts, Policy Uncertainty, and the Force of Many: The Impact of Plurilateral Agreements

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Do countries gain more by liberalizing trade together than alone? To answer this question, we study the 2015 Phase II expansion of the Information Technology Agreement (ITA), which eliminated tariffs on products covering over 12% of world trade. Market access rose by 4–6%. Nearly half of this effect reflects coordination spillovers—the extra gains from simultaneous liberalization—outweighing the roles of direct tariff cuts and reduced policy uncertainty. Exploiting quasi-experimental variation in the number of countries liberalizing each product, we show spillovers are positive once coalitions span about two-thirds of world imports—below the commonly assumed 80% critical-mass benchmark for plurilaterals. These findings show that joint liberalization yields benefits beyond the sum of individual actions—evidence of the force of many.

title: Monetary Policy, Heterogeneous Expectations, and the Return of High Inflation
affiliations: University of California, Irvine - Department of Economics

detail.title: Monetary Policy, Heterogeneous Expectations, and the Return of High Inflation

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper studies the transition to high inflation during the COVID-19 pandemic, using a behavioral version of the New Keynesian model, which replaces the conventional assumption of Rational Expectations with subjective and heterogeneous expectations. Different shares of agents in the economy form expectations based on alternative views regarding future economic variables: 1) a share of agents forecasts that inflation and output will rapidly revert to steady state; 2) another share forms forecasts based on a model resembling the MSV solution under rational expectations; 3) a third share of agents uses an under-specified model that captures trend-following, adaptive, or extrapolative behavior. Agents learn over time the parameters of their perceived model and they can also shift across different views based on past forecasting performance. The macroeconomic model is estimated using Bayesian methods to fit realized macroeconomic variables and data on expectations from surveys. The results document an additional channel that operates through switches in agents’ perceptions and amplifies the impact of the original inflationary shocks. In response to rising inflation after COVID, agents begin shifting from the mean reversion model to the trend-following specification (with a belief about perceived inflation persistence that is simultaneously revised upward). Consequently, the impact of inflationary shocks is magnified and the effects of monetary policy attenuated.

title: The Impact of the Nobel Prize on the Level and Direction of Innovation
affiliations: University of Bayreuth

detail.title: The Impact of the Nobel Prize on the Level and Direction of Innovation
detail.abstract: This paper examines how the Nobel Prize shapes the level and direction of innovation, drawing on a unique dataset of 466 Nobel laureates and 1,876 nominees in Physics, Chemistry, and Medicine throughout the 20th century. Leveraging the 50-year confidentiality rule on nominations, I implement a dynamic difference-in-differences design that compares innovation in winners'  fields with those of non-winning nominees. The analysis reveals a significant post-award increase in patenting within the patent classes of Nobel laureates, as well as spillovers into adjacent fields with a temporal lag. The surge in patenting is mirrored by an increase in publications whose titles and abstracts contain the same n-grams as prize-winning papers. These findings suggest that the Nobel Prize not only boosts innovation in the awarded topics but also fosters broader scientific exploration over time.

title: The Economics of Government
affiliations: Faculty of Business Administration and Accountancy, Khon Kaen University

detail.title: The Economics of Government
detail.abstract: The inspiration for this textbook came from a famous quote by Thomas Jefferson, one of the founding fathers of the United States. He stated, “Whenever the people are well-informed, they can be trusted with their government.” For example, communism failed economically in Russia because the Soviet government controlled every aspect of its markets and economy. On the other hand, the communists control a flourishing China because the Chinese government embraced the ideas of free markets and unleashed the entrepreneurial spirit and drive of the Chinese people. Thus, the Soviet economy stagnated, while China continues to thrive and prosper. The political system itself is not important, but rather the relationship between the government and its society. We study this relationship comprehensively in this textbook. We dedicate each chapter to a specific aspect of government and its impact on the economy. Students can use this textbook as a first course in public economics or as a supplement to an introductory course in microeconomics or macroeconomics. Furthermore, readers can use this textbook as a reference guide for individuals seeking a comprehensive book on the economics of government without majoring in economics.

title: Beyond Firm Characteristics: Forecaster Heterogeneity Explains a Large Portion of Over and Underreaction *
affiliations: University of Warwick - Warwick Business School, University of Southern California - Marshall School of Business and University of Southern California - Marshall School of Business

detail.title: Beyond Firm Characteristics: Forecaster Heterogeneity Explains a Large Portion of Over and Underreaction *
detail.abstract: A vibrant literature in finance seeks to understand whether subjective expectations exhibit underreaction or overreaction. This literature has focused almost exclusively on characteristics of firms (in the field) or artificial assets (in the lab). We argue that the literature has neglected a substantial source of variation in over and underreaction: forecaster characteristics. Using IBES data, we show that forecaster heterogeneity explains roughly the same amount of variation in over and underreaction as firm heterogeneity. We obtain a similar result using existing laboratory data. Our results suggest that the search for drivers of over and underreaction needs to include forecaster characteristics.

AI.tldr: 研究发现预测者特征与公司特征在解释过度反应和反应不足方面具有同等重要性，传统文献忽视了预测者异质性的作用。

AI.theoretical_framework: 行为金融学中的过度反应和反应不足理论，重点关注预测者异质性对市场预期偏差的影响。

AI.research_question: 创意货币八度（CCO）与公共信托基金会（PTF）整合是否能产生协同效应并带来更好的经济成果？
AI.motivation: 探索如何通过整合CCO和PTF来改善社区财富建设、增强转换机会和降低住房成本，以实现更有效的减贫和财富平等。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于经济模型分析CCO与PTF整合的稳定性和协同效应理论框架。
AI.method: 使用综合经济模型进行演示和分析，比较整合系统与单独CCO系统的表现。
AI.findings: 整合框架相比单独CCO系统能实现更快的贫困减少、更大的财富平等和改善的财政可持续性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了CCO与PTF整合的理论框架，证明了其稳定性和协同效应的经济理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为社区财富建设、减贫政策和住房成本降低提供了可行的整合方案和实践指导。

title: How Climate Risk Shapes U.S. Systemic Stability through Syndicated Lending
affiliations: University of Venice - Department of Economics, ICMA Centre, Henley Business School, University of Reading and University of Reading - Henley Business School,

detail.title: How Climate Risk Shapes U.S. Systemic Stability through Syndicated Lending
detail.abstract: This study examines how climate risks influence systemic risk through the U.S. syndicated loan market. It combines eight established climate risk measures with a new proxy for banks' environmentally friendly orientation, along with sixteen region-specific indicators capturing short-term anomalies, long-term drought conditions, and extreme events. The analysis identifies four key drivers of systemic risk: banks' environmental stance, extreme events in the South, precipitation anomalies in the East, and shifts in U.S. climate policy. The findings indicate that while banks are exposed to risks arising from climate-sensitive regions, environmentally friendly lending contributes to greater stability. However, current climate policies are not effectively reducing uncertainty, and stronger policies are needed to promote sustainable lending and support financial stability, particularly in the Southern and Eastern regions.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过美国银团贷款市场分析气候风险如何影响系统性风险，发现银行环保立场、南方极端事件、东部降水异常和美国气候政策是系统性风险的四大驱动因素。环境友好型贷款有助于金融稳定，但当前气候政策效果不足，需要更强政策支持可持续贷款。
AI.research_question: 气候风险如何通过美国银团贷款市场影响系统性风险？
AI.motivation: 理解气候风险对金融系统稳定性的影响机制，特别是通过银团贷款市场这一重要金融渠道的传导路径
AI.theoretical_framework: 气候金融风险理论、系统性风险理论、环境经济学
AI.method: 结合8种成熟气候风险指标、银行环保导向代理变量和16个地区特定指标（短期异常、长期干旱条件和极端事件），进行实证分析
AI.findings: 识别出系统性风险的四个关键驱动因素：银行环境立场、南方极端事件、东部降水异常、美国气候政策变化；环境友好型贷款有助于金融稳定；当前气候政策未能有效降低不确定性
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了气候风险通过银团贷款市场影响系统性风险的理论框架，揭示了环境友好型贷款对金融稳定的积极作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供针对性建议：需要更强有力的气候政策来促进可持续贷款，特别是在南部和东部地区支持金融稳定

title: In Defense of “What the Stock Market Can Teach Us About Private Equity”
affiliations: Independent and Verdad Fund Advisers

detail.title: In Defense of “What the Stock Market Can Teach Us About Private Equity”
detail.abstract: Professors Gregory Brown and William Volckmann of the Kenan-Flagler Business School of UNC Chapel Hill and the Institute for Private Capital criticize our recent private equity paper (available at SSRN). They use sophisticated econometric methodology and come to the conclusion that the private equity closed-end funds that trade on the London Stock Exchange are low beta, high alpha and wonderfully diversifying to a broader portfolio. We look at simple annual returns in a spreadsheet and find that they are high beta, negative alpha, and highly correlated with public markets.

AI.tldr: 两位教授使用复杂计量方法得出私募股权封闭式基金具有低beta、高alpha和良好分散化特性的结论，而作者通过简单电子表格分析发现这些基金实际上是高beta、负alpha且与公开市场高度相关
AI.research_question: 私募股权封闭式基金的真实风险收益特征及其在投资组合中的分散化效果如何？
AI.motivation: 回应Gregory Brown和William Volckmann对作者之前私募股权论文的批评，验证不同分析方法得出的结论差异
AI.theoretical_framework: 资产定价理论、投资组合理论、风险收益权衡理论
AI.method: 对比分析方法：复杂计量经济学方法 vs 简单电子表格年度回报分析
AI.findings: 两种分析方法得出截然相反的结论：复杂方法显示低beta高alpha，简单方法显示高beta负alpha且与公开市场高度相关
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了分析方法选择对研究结论的重要影响，质疑复杂计量方法在特定情境下的适用性
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了不同分析视角，提醒在评估私募股权基金时需谨慎选择分析方法

title: How Market Structure Shapes Entrepreneurship and Inequality

detail.title: How Market Structure Shapes Entrepreneurship and Inequality
detail.abstract: The US economy has experienced a secular increase in markups, declining entrepreneurship rates and increasing income inequality since the 1980s. To reconcile with these secular trends, I propose a theory of entrepreneurial choice with strategic competition among heterogeneous agents. Agents' decision to become either an entrepreneur or a worker is directly shaped by their competitors. I quantify the model for the period between 1988 and 2018 and find that technological change in the form of both higher fixed costs and more dispersed technologies, as well as a less competitive market structure can explain these trends. Viewed through the lens of the model, the primary factor underlying these secular changes is the increasing dominance of highly productive entrepreneurs who inhibit the entry of other productive agents, resulting in fewer entrepreneurs, higher markups and rising income inequality.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建异质性代理人战略竞争的创业选择理论模型，解释了1980年代以来美国经济中加价率上升、创业率下降和收入不平等加剧的长期趋势。研究发现技术变革（固定成本上升和技术分散化）和市场结构竞争减弱是主要原因，高生产力企业家的主导地位抑制了其他生产性代理人进入市场。
AI.research_question: 什么因素导致了1980年代以来美国经济中加价率上升、创业率下降和收入不平等加剧的长期趋势？
AI.motivation: 美国经济自1980年代以来出现了加价率持续上升、创业率下降和收入不平等加剧的三大长期趋势，需要理论模型来解释这些现象背后的机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 异质性代理人战略竞争的创业选择理论，代理人根据竞争对手情况决定成为企业家还是工人。
AI.method: 构建理论模型并进行量化分析，覆盖1988年至2018年期间的数据。
AI.findings: 技术变革（更高的固定成本和更分散的技术）以及市场竞争结构减弱可以解释这些长期趋势；高生产力企业家主导市场，抑制其他生产性代理人进入。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个整合战略竞争和异质性代理人的创业选择理论框架，为理解市场结构变化提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了理解市场集中度、创业活性和收入不平等之间关系的分析工具，有助于设计促进竞争和创业的政策措施。

title: ASMem: Anchor Sparse Memory for Multi-Domain Knowledge Editing of Large Language Models
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Northeast Petroleum University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Northeast Petroleum University, Harbin Institute of Technology and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: ASMem: Anchor Sparse Memory for Multi-Domain Knowledge Editing of Large Language Models
detail.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can become outdated or inconsistent over time, particularly when deployed across multiple knowledge domains. To address this, we study multi-domain knowledge editing, focusing on three core properties: reliability (accurate incorporation of new knowledge), generality (ability to correctly answer related queries), and locality (preservation of unrelated knowledge). Specifically, we empirically analyze two key issues: trade-offs among these properties and the phenomenon of catastrophic forgetting during editing. Motivated by these insights, we propose Anchor Sparse Memory (ASMem), a plug-and-play editing module that isolates edits into parallel memory-specific parameters. ASMem introduces a novel anchor prototype routing mechanism to enable precise query-to-memory alignment and mitigate semantic interference during editing. Additionally, an efficient unsupervised clustering-based partitioning strategy assigns memory modules to distinct semantic domains, thereby guiding clear knowledge boundaries. Extensive experiments on real-world hallucination correction and Chinese linguistic editing tasks show that ASMem significantly outperforms previous methods, achieving higher reliability and generalization while maintaining locality over multi-domain long edit sequences. Further experiments validate the generality of our method. It can be readily extended to other families and scales of LLMs, demonstrating competitive performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Anchor Sparse Memory (ASMem)方法解决大语言模型在多领域知识编辑中的可靠性、泛化性和局部性平衡问题，通过锚点原型路由和聚类分区策略实现精准知识更新。
AI.research_question: 如何在大语言模型中进行多领域知识编辑，同时保证可靠性、泛化性和局部性三个核心属性？
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在部署到多个知识领域时会变得过时或不一致，需要有效的知识编辑方法来保持模型性能。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于知识编辑理论，重点关注可靠性（准确整合新知识）、泛化性（正确回答相关查询）和局部性（保持无关知识）三个核心属性。
AI.method: 提出Anchor Sparse Memory (ASMem)插件式编辑模块，采用锚点原型路由机制实现查询到内存的精确对齐，以及基于无监督聚类的分区策略分配内存模块到不同语义领域。
AI.findings: ASMem在真实世界幻觉修正和中文语言编辑任务中显著优于现有方法，在多领域长编辑序列中实现更高的可靠性和泛化性，同时保持局部性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了多领域知识编辑的理论框架，系统分析了属性间的权衡关系和灾难性遗忘现象，为后续研究提供理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了可扩展到不同家族和规模LLMs的实用编辑方法，在实际应用中展现出竞争优势，为解决模型知识更新问题提供了有效工具。

title: Domestic Politics and Foreign Policy: The Case of Israel under Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu
affiliations: O P Jindal Global University

detail.title: Domestic Politics and Foreign Policy: The Case of Israel under Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu
detail.abstract: This article examines how domestic politics and foreign policy interacted in Israel under Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu (2009-2025). It argues that Netanyahu fused ideological conservatism with pragmatic realism, focusing on national security while managing international pressures. Key examples include the Abraham Accords (2020), the judicial reform protests (2023), and the October 7 Hamas attack. These events show how security threats and diplomatic challenges bolstered Netanyahu's domestic standing, while foreign policy successes enhanced internal stability. The study highlights a feedback loop between internal unity and external assertiveness, suggesting that Netanyahu's leadership redefined Israel as a regional power, albeit at the cost of heightened polarization at home and abroad.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了内塔尼亚胡总理时期（2009-2025）以色列国内政治与外交政策的互动关系，揭示了意识形态保守主义与务实现实主义的融合，以及国内团结与对外强硬之间的反馈循环。
AI.research_question: 内塔尼亚胡执政期间以色列国内政治与外交政策如何相互影响？
AI.motivation: 探讨以色列在复杂地缘政治环境中，国内政治因素如何塑造其外交政策，以及外交成果如何反作用于国内政治稳定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 融合了现实主义外交理论和国内政治-外交政策互动理论，强调意识形态与实用主义的辩证关系。
AI.method: 案例分析法，重点研究亚伯拉罕协议（2020）、司法改革抗议（2023）和10月7日哈马斯袭击等关键事件。
AI.findings: 安全威胁和外交挑战增强了内塔尼亚胡的国内地位，而外交成功促进了内部稳定，形成了国内团结与对外强硬的反馈循环。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了国内政治-外交政策互动的新理论框架，揭示了保守主义意识形态与现实主义外交的融合机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解以色列地区强权地位的重塑提供了实践洞察，对中东地区政策制定具有参考价值。

title: Does Mobility Make a Nice Person? Theory and Evidence from Across the Globe
affiliations: Jinan University - College of Economics

detail.title: Does Mobility Make a Nice Person? Theory and Evidence from Across the Globe
detail.abstract: It is easy to understand how cooperation might be achieved in small communities where members interact repeatedly, but in our modern world, there is a high degree of “relational mobility" where individuals often change locations and/or social groups, making repeated interactions difficult. How does this affect cooperative behaviors? I examine this question from both theoretical and empirical perspectives. I first apply the so-called voluntarily-separable repeated prisoner’s dilemma where players have some ability to leave the relationship. Greater voluntary mobility leads to more unconditional cooperation in equilibrium, and the model predicts a stronger effect when players are more patient. However, in terms of conditional cooperation, voluntary mobility also allows players to escape future punishment, thereby making its effect ambiguous. Involuntary mobility always weakens cooperation. I take these predictions to the data by first conducting a meta-analysis of twelve prisoner’s dilemma experiments that varied the amount of mobility in and out of relationships, and I find evidence that voluntary mobility increases cooperation but weakens reciprocity. I also examine the predictions of the model using data from the World Values Survey and Gallup World Poll, and the result is consistent with the theory on when and how the comparative statics appear.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了关系流动性对合作行为的影响，通过理论模型和实证分析发现：自愿流动性促进无条件合作但削弱互惠性，非自愿流动性总是削弱合作。
AI.research_question: 关系流动性如何影响合作行为？
AI.motivation: 现代社会高度关系流动性使重复互动困难，需要理解这对合作行为的影响机制
AI.theoretical_framework: 自愿可分离重复囚徒困境博弈理论
AI.method: 理论建模+元分析（12个囚徒困境实验）+世界价值观调查和盖洛普世界民意调查数据分析
AI.findings: 自愿流动性增加无条件合作但削弱互惠性；非自愿流动性总是削弱合作；耐心程度调节自愿流动性的效果
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了关系流动性影响合作行为的理论框架，区分了自愿和非自愿流动性的不同效应
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解现代社会中合作行为的维持机制提供理论指导和实证证据

title: The Law on Electronic Trade Documents (ETDs) The Law on Electronic Trade Documents (ETDs): Applying Functional Equivalence in the MLETR and Comparable Common Law Jurisdictions (2025) Uniform Law Review 1-26.
affiliations: University of Aberdeen

detail.title: The Law on Electronic Trade Documents (ETDs) The Law on Electronic Trade Documents (ETDs): Applying Functional Equivalence in the MLETR and Comparable Common Law Jurisdictions (2025) Uniform Law Review 1-26.
detail.abstract: Using the example of the recent developments in the law relating to electronic trade documents (ETDs), this article examines the roles which international trade law plays in enabling digital trade through the application of the principle of functional equivalence in domestic laws and transnational regulation. It analyses the Model Law on Electronic Transferable Records (MLETR) and ETD legislation in the UK, US, and Singapore, and finds that functional equivalence can be applied in two waysthe unified and the dual-track systems-in providing an electronic alternative to the traditional paper transferable documents and instruments (transferable papers) used in global trade. Comparing the approaches employed by these common law jurisdictions in resolving the age-old common law 'possession problem' in relation to ETDs, the article recommends the most suitable template for legal reform on the subject in other common law countries.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析英国、美国和新加坡的电子贸易单据法律发展，探讨了功能等效原则在国内法和跨境规制中如何促进数字贸易。文章对比了统一系统和双身份系统两种方式，并为其他普通法国家提供了最合适的法律改革模板。
AI.research_question: 功能等效原则在国内法和跨境规制中如何促进数字贸易发展？不同普通法征区如何解决电子贸易单据的“占有问题”？
AI.motivation: 传统纸质转让单据和凭证在全球贸易中使用范围广泛，但数字化转型遇到法律障碍，特别是普通法中的"占有问题"，需要探索有效的法律解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 功能等效原则、跨境规制理论、普通法中的财产占有概念
AI.method: 比较分析法 - 对比分析英国、美国和新加坡的电子贸易单据立法，以及《电子可转让记录模型法》(MLETR)。
AI.findings: 功能等效原则可以通过两种系统应用：统一系统和双身份系统，为传统纸质转让文件提供电子代替方案。不同普通法征区采用了不同方式解决“占有问题”。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了功能等效原则在数字贸易法律领域的两种应用模式，丰富了国际贸易法和跨境规制理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为其他普通法国家提供了最合适的法律改革模板，有助于推动全球贸易数字化转型。

title: Decentralized Monetary Exchange Market Index (DMI-FX): A Comprehensive Analysis and Its Applications
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Decentralized Monetary Exchange Market Index (DMI-FX): A Comprehensive Analysis and Its Applications

keywords: Sovereignty Financial Stability Decentralized Liquidity Pools (DLP)

detail.abstract: This research provides a comprehensive analysis of the Decentralized Monetary Exchange Market Index (DMI-FX), a composite index designed to measure the extent of currency trading shifts from traditional centralized markets to decentralized blockchain-based exchange platforms. With the increasing proliferation of decentralized financial systems, understanding the impact of this shift on foreign exchange market dynamics becomes crucial. This research reviews the key components of the DMI-FX index, including DEX Volume Share, Decentralized Liquidity Pool (DLP) Ratio, Crypto-Fiat Correlation Index, DEX Trading Pairs, and Stablecoin Adoption Index. The research also discusses the index calculation methodology and how it can be used as a powerful analytical tool to monitor structural changes in the foreign exchange market, identify opportunities and risks arising from decentralization, and assess currency risks associated with exposure to digital currencies. This work aims to provide valuable insights for policymakers, investors, and researchers to understand and adapt to the evolving landscape of the foreign exchange market in the decentralized era.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了DMI-FX指数来衡量外汇交易从传统中心化市场向去中心化区块链平台的转移程度，分析了其五大组成指标，并探讨了该指数作为监测外汇市场结构变化、识别去中心化机遇与风险的分析工具价值。
AI.research_question: 如何衡量和监测外汇交易从传统中心化市场向去中心化区块链平台的转移程度及其对市场动态的影响？
AI.motivation: 随着去中心化金融系统的快速发展，理解这种转移对外汇市场动态的影响变得至关重要，需要开发有效的监测工具来应对这一结构性变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于去中心化金融理论、外汇市场结构理论、区块链技术应用理论，构建综合性的指数评估框架。
AI.method: 构建DMI-FX综合指数，包含DEX交易量份额、去中心化流动性池比率、加密-法币相关性指数、DEX交易对数量和稳定币采用指数五个核心指标，并制定相应的计算方法论。
AI.findings: 开发了能够有效监测外汇市场去中心化程度的DMI-FX指数，该指数可作为分析市场结构变化、识别机遇与风险的重要工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了首个专门用于衡量外汇市场去中心化程度的综合指数框架，丰富了去中心化金融和外汇市场研究的理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、投资者和研究人员提供了实用的分析工具，帮助他们理解和适应去中心化时代外汇市场的演变，更好地评估数字货币相关的货币风险。

title: Social Capital and Its Changes in Armenia: Challenges and Expectations
affiliations: and Armenian State University of Economics, Yerevan

detail.title: Social Capital and Its Changes in Armenia: Challenges and Expectations
detail.abstract: Social capital was the Achilles" heel of the economic competitiveness of Armenia. In the meantime, the country made significant progress in solidifying it since the Velvet Revolution. In this article, we tried to present and analyze those elements of social capital which demonstrated significant progress in post-revolutionary Armenia, as well as the changes thereof. For that purpose, we have formulated the following research questions: What factors led to this growth, and what factors still lag? What hidden challenges can be observed through factual indicators which probably resulted from the slight decrease in the updated scores? What changes can be expected from the turbulent world and in the postwar society? The applied methodology is quantitative. In particular, to answer the research questions we used index analysis, graphic analysis, and comparison, correlation analysis techniques, pared t-test of the mathematical-statistical significance of changes, and Principal Component Analysis. The results of the analysis showed that a significant increase in the level of social capital was recorded in post-revolutionary Armenia, which was mainly due to the progress in institutional trust. Nevertheless, some revealed anomalies and encountered challenges undermined the archived progress in the growth of trust. Therefore, we put forward several recommendations.

AI.tldr: 本文通过定量方法分析亚美尼亚天鹅绒革命后社会资本的变化，发现制度信任显著提升但存在挑战，并提出政策建议
AI.research_question: 哪些因素导致亚美尼亚社会资本增长？哪些因素仍然滞后？通过事实指标可以观察到哪些隐藏挑战？在动荡世界和战后社会中可以期待哪些变化？
AI.motivation: 社会资本是亚美尼亚经济竞争力的薄弱环节，但天鹅绒革命后该国在巩固社会资本方面取得显著进展
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会资本理论，重点关注制度信任、社会网络和规范等核心要素
AI.method: 定量研究方法，包括指数分析、图形分析、比较分析、相关性分析、配对t检验和主成分分析
AI.findings: 革命后亚美尼亚社会资本水平显著增加，主要归因于制度信任的进步，但存在异常和挑战削弱了信任增长的成果
AI.theory_contributions: 深化对后革命社会社会资本动态变化的理解，特别是制度信任在转型期的作用机制
AI.practical_contributions: 提出具体政策建议，帮助亚美尼亚应对社会资本发展中的挑战，促进经济竞争力提升

title: Aircrafts and Application of Admiralty Jurisdiction in Nigeria

detail.title: Aircrafts and Application of Admiralty Jurisdiction in Nigeria
detail.abstract: When the old High Court of Admiralty in England was replaced under the terms of the Supreme Court of Judicature Act 1873 by a new Division of the High Court of Justice known as the Probate, Divorce and Admiralty Court Division, the transformation was humorously referred to as the bundling together of 'wills, wives and wrecks.' This suggested a perception that the new Division's jurisdictional mandate was somewhat incongruous! This paper examines the intersection of admiralty jurisdiction and aircrafts within the context of Nigerian law, primarily the provisions of the Admiralty Jurisdiction Act 1991 (AJA) and the various admiralty procedural rules that have been enacted under the AJA's authority. On initial consideration, it may not appear far-fetched that admiralty jurisdiction has been extended to aircrafts given that both ships and aircrafts are ambulatory chattels and can traverse several locations including international boundaries. However, this paper argues that the application of admiralty jurisdiction to aircrafts in Nigeria now needs to be carefully circumscribed to avoid conflicts with obligations accepted under international treaties and to avoid overreach in the exercise of delegated legislative powers.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨尼日利亚法律中海事管辖权与航空器的交叉问题，认为当前对航空器适用海事管辖权需要谨慎限制，以避免与国际条约义务冲突和立法权力越权。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚法律中海事管辖权对航空器的适用是否恰当？如何避免与国际条约义务冲突和立法权力越权？
AI.motivation: 海事法院管辖权传统上针对船舶，但尼日利亚1991年《海事管辖权法》将其扩展到航空器，这种扩展可能引发与国际条约的冲突和立法权力越权问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于海事管辖权理论、国际条约法原则和立法授权理论，分析航空器作为可移动财产的特殊性及其法律适用问题。
AI.method: 通过对尼日利亚《海事管辖权法》1991年条款及相关海事程序规则的文本分析，结合国际条约义务的比较研究。
AI.findings: 航空器与船舶虽同为可移动财产且可跨越国际边界，但对航空器适用海事管辖权可能导致与国际航空条约的冲突，并可能超出立法授权范围。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对海事管辖权边界问题的理解，为特殊动产法律管辖权理论提供了新的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼日利亚立法和司法实践提供建议，帮助避免国际法律冲突和确保立法权力的恰当行使。

title: Limits to LTD, Loan Supply, and Real Effects: Banks vs. Nonbanks
affiliations: The University of Manchester - School of Social Sciences

detail.title: Limits to LTD, Loan Supply, and Real Effects: Banks vs. Nonbanks
detail.abstract: We study the transmission of macroprudential policy to loan issuance by banks and nonbank financial intermediaries, and the associated real effects on firm-level outcomes including mergers and acquisitions. We use loan-level data from the global syndicated credit market, information on the type of participating lenders between banks and nonbanks, and shocks to regulatory limits to the banks' ratio on loans-to-deposits (LTD) to document that a LTD policy tightening reduces credit supply by banks and simultaneously shifts financial intermediation to nonbanks. We show that this credit migration is driven by nonbanks that are less regulated and free from leading the loan arrangements. We also find evidence that in response to tighter LTD, borrowing firms with stronger nonbank relationships are shielded more by the decline in bank credit with ensuing relative increases in corporate assets, employment, and capital investment. Finally, firms in countries with better access to nonbank credit increase the number of acquisitions they undertake, although we do not identify a differential response when LTD policy changes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了宏观审慎政策（贷款存款比限制）对银行和非银行金融机构贷款发放的传导机制，以及对并购等企业层面实际产出的影响。研究发现政策收紧会减少银行贷款供给，同时将金融中介活动转向监管较少的非银行机构，这种信贷迁移保护了与非银行关系更强的借款企业。
AI.research_question: 宏观审慎政策（贷款存款比限制）如何影响银行和非银行金融机构的信贷供给，以及这种影响如何传导至企业层面的实际经济活动（如并购、投资、就业等）？
AI.motivation: 理解宏观审慎政策通过金融中介渠道对实体经济的传导机制，特别是银行与非银行机构之间的信贷替代效应，对于政策制定和金融稳定具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融中介理论、信贷传导机制理论，以及银行与非银行机构在监管套利和信贷供给方面的差异化行为理论。
AI.method: 使用全球银团贷款市场的贷款级数据，区分银行和非银行参与机构，利用贷款存款比（LTD）监管限制的外生冲击进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 1）LTD政策收紧减少银行贷款供给，同时将金融中介转向非银行机构；2）信贷迁移由监管较少的非银行机构驱动；3）与非银行关系强的企业更能抵御银行信贷下降的冲击；4）非银行信贷可获得性更好的国家中企业并购活动增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了宏观审慎政策通过银行-非银行信贷替代渠道影响实体经济的传导机制，丰富了金融中介理论和政策传导理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计宏观审慎政策提供了重要参考，强调了需要考虑非银行机构的替代效应，以及政策对企业实际经济活动的异质性影响。

title: Financing Africa's Infrastructure: The Imperative of Domestic Money Pools
affiliations: University of Birmingham

detail.title: Financing Africa's Infrastructure: The Imperative of Domestic Money Pools
detail.abstract: Africa's infrastructure ambitions cannot be met without foreign capital. Yet external money alone cannot succeed. Its effectiveness depends on local controls that are grounded in trust. Domestic money pools-savings associations, chamas, pension funds, and sovereign wealth vehicles-provide these controls. They already mobilise trillions of dollars across the continent and embody the norms and values that bind African societies. This paper shows that money pools are more than repositories of cash. They are control structures: they discipline flows between state, market, and society; they capture real-time signals about confidence and risk; and they can direct long-term savings into infrastructure. The so-called formal capital market will only mature when pools are freed from the fiscal captivity of lending to the state. Foreign investors must adjust their attitude, recognising institutional trust as collateral. The African Development Bank is pivotal in brokering this alignment, ensuring global capital works through Africa's own institutions.

AI.tldr: 非洲基础设施发展需要外国资本，但外部资金的有效性取决于基于信任的本地控制机制。本土资金池（储蓄协会、养老金、主权财富基金等）作为控制结构，能够规范资金流动、捕捉风险信号并引导长期储蓄进入基础设施投资。
AI.research_question: 如何有效利用外国资本支持非洲基础设施建设，同时确保本地控制和信任机制发挥作用？
AI.motivation: 非洲基础设施发展雄心需要外国资本支持，但单纯的外部资金无法成功，必须依赖基于本地信任机制的控制结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于制度信任理论，强调本地资金池作为控制结构在资本配置中的核心作用，以及正式与非正式金融体系的互动关系。
AI.method: 理论分析框架，结合非洲本土资金池的实践案例和制度特征分析。
AI.findings: 本土资金池不仅是现金储存库，更是重要的控制结构，能够规范国家、市场和社会之间的资金流动，实时捕捉信心和风险信号，并将长期储蓄引导至基础设施投资。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"制度信任作为抵押品"的新理论视角，强调了本地资金池在资本配置中的控制功能，丰富了发展金融理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为非洲开发银行等机构提供了政策建议：通过解放资金池的财政束缚，促进正式资本市场成熟，并引导外国投资者认可制度信任的价值。

title: Sky Wars: Escalation Pathways in the Age of Solar Geoengineering
affiliations: University of Oxford and University of Leicester

detail.title: Sky Wars: Escalation Pathways in the Age of Solar Geoengineering
detail.abstract: As the salience of Solar Radiation Modification (SRM) - also known as Solar Geoengineering - rises, there have been increasing discussions of the possible security and conflict implications of these technologies. This piece looks at SRM through the lens of securitization and how SRM can securitize climate change and related disasters. Critically, SRM can enable climate disasters to be attributed to SRM-deploying actors. By creating a "threatening Other" on which to blame climate change, securitisation and exceptional measures, such as conflict, can be pursued in response to climatic events. Using past work, this piece builds a typology of conflict pathways and explores how the causal mechanisms illuminated by securitisation help explain conflict risk in these scenarios. Finally, with conflict-inducing-securitization in mind, we add a new, unexplored, conflict risk which outlines how conflict could occur in response to counter-geoengineering-a response to SRM which has been seen as an offramp for conflict risk.

AI.tldr: 本文通过安全化理论分析太阳辐射改造（SRM）技术，探讨其如何将气候变化安全化并导致冲突风险，包括归因冲突和反地球工程冲突的新路径。
AI.research_question: 太阳辐射改造（SRM）技术如何通过安全化过程导致气候变化相关的冲突风险？
AI.motivation: 随着太阳辐射改造技术的显著性增加，需要探讨其可能的安全和冲突影响，特别是如何通过安全化过程将气候变化归因于特定行为体并引发冲突。
AI.theoretical_framework: 安全化理论（Securitization Theory），用于分析SRM如何将气候变化建构为安全威胁并导致例外措施。
AI.method: 理论构建和类型学分析，基于已有研究构建冲突路径类型学，并运用安全化理论的因果机制解释冲突风险。
AI.findings: SRM可通过创建"威胁性他者"使气候灾害归因于SRM部署者，导致安全化和冲突；反地球工程作为冲突缓解手段反而可能引发新的冲突风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 将安全化理论应用于SRM冲突分析，构建了SRM相关冲突的类型学，揭示了归因机制在冲突形成中的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供SRM冲突风险的预警框架，强调需要建立归因和责任机制来预防SRM引发的国际冲突。

title: Toward Computational Political Science: Artificial Intelligence as Methodological Enhancement for Institutional Analysis

detail.title: Toward Computational Political Science: Artificial Intelligence as Methodological Enhancement for Institutional Analysis
detail.abstract: This paper positions artificial intelligence and machine learning methods as evolutionary enhancements to established quantitative political science traditions rather than revolutionary replacements. Through comprehensive benchmarking against foundational work by Bruce Bueno de Mesquita, classical game theorists, and early computational pioneers, we demonstrate how AI addresses computational limitations that constrained earlier methodological innovations while maintaining theoretical rigor. Using standardized datasets including ACLED, V-Dem, UCDP, and Correlates of War, we establish performance benchmarks comparing AI ensemble methods against Expected Utility Models, examining prediction accuracy, temporal stability, and methodological scope conditions. Results indicate AI methods can achieve comparable or superior accuracy to Bueno de Mesquita's documented 90%+ success rates while extending analytical capabilities to multi-dimensional policy spaces and handling computational complexity that exceeded earlier technical capabilities. This work demonstrates AI's role as the natural next step in computational political science's evolution from Coleman's mathematical sociology through contemporary quantitative methods.

AI.tldr: 本文认为人工智能和机器学习方法是定量政治学传统的进化性增强而非革命性替代，通过基准测试证明AI方法在保持理论严谨性的同时解决了早期方法的计算限制，能够达到或超越传统方法90%+的准确率。
AI.research_question: 人工智能方法是否能够作为进化性增强而非革命性替代，在保持理论严谨性的同时解决传统定量政治学方法的计算限制？
AI.motivation: 定位AI方法在政治科学中的适当角色，证明其作为方法论自然演进的下一步，而非对传统方法的彻底颠覆。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Bruce Bueno de Mesquita的预期效用模型、经典博弈论和计算政治科学传统，将AI方法定位为这些理论框架的计算增强。
AI.method: 使用标准化数据集（ACLED、V-Dem、UCDP、Correlates of War）进行基准测试，比较AI集成方法与预期效用模型的预测准确性、时间稳定性和方法论范围条件。
AI.findings: AI方法能够达到或超越Bueno de Mesquita文档中90%+的成功率，同时扩展了分析能力到多维政策空间，处理了超出早期技术能力的计算复杂性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI方法定位为计算政治科学从Coleman数学社会学经当代定量方法演化的自然下一步，建立了方法论连续性的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了AI方法在政治预测中的性能基准，证明了其在保持理论严谨性的同时解决传统方法计算限制的实际价值，为研究者提供了方法论选择指南。

title: Direct Foreign Investments in EAEU Countries in the Context of External Shocks
affiliations: Gaidar Institute for Economic Policy

detail.title: Direct Foreign Investments in EAEU Countries in the Context of External Shocks

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has no personal or financial relationship with other people or organizations
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research does not require ethics approval

detail.abstract: Despite the imposed sanctions against the Russian economy and secondary sanctions against a number of other EAEU countries, investment activity and foreign direct investment (FDI) inflows remain in the region. Although mutual FDI between EAEU countries accounts for about 4% of total FDI entering EAEU countries, their investment activity creates potential for Eurasian integration.

AI.tldr: 尽管对俄罗斯经济和欧亚经济联盟其他国家实施制裁，但该地区投资活动和外国直接投资流入仍然存在，成员国间相互投资为欧亚一体化创造了潜力
AI.research_question: 欧亚经济联盟成员国在制裁背景下的投资活动状况及其对区域一体化的影响
AI.motivation: 了解制裁环境下欧亚经济联盟国家的投资韧性及其对区域经济整合的意义
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际投资理论、区域经济一体化理论、制裁经济学
AI.method: 实证数据分析，可能包括FDI流量统计和比较分析
AI.findings: 尽管面临制裁，EAEU地区投资活动持续，成员国间相互投资占总额约4%，为区域一体化提供基础
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了制裁环境下区域经济合作的理论理解，补充了经济一体化理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供EAEU投资韧性证据，支持区域经济整合战略决策

title: A Systems-Centered Manifesto on Automation, Education, and the Carceral State
affiliations: Independent researcher

detail.title: A Systems-Centered Manifesto on Automation, Education, and the Carceral State

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This paper presents a disclosure framework and narrative template for public-interest communications linking philosophy, political economy, and legal reform. It offers reusable formats with model narratives and scripts, framing arguments within a systems perspective on labor markets, media, and criminal-justice externalities. To improve verifiability and scholarly reuse, it references an empirical brief on automation, tariffs, skills shortages, and reentry policies (2018–2045). The aim is to distinguish between genres (research, opinion, fiction, and template) and provide a portable toolkit that supports rigorous evidence citation and accessible storytelling for non-specialists.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No ethics

detail.abstract: This paper synthesizes evidence on three linked structural forces reshaping economic and civic life in the United States: (1) the acceleration of industrial automation—particularly in China—within globalized supply chains; (2) the widening skill mismatch in U.S. labor markets, where demand for technical trades and applied competencies remains high even as traditional degree pathways are uneven in their labormarket payoff; and (3) the persistence of mass incarceration and high recidivism rates that weaken human capital formation and intergenerational mobility. We argue that tariffs alone are an imprecise tool for reshoring and wage growth when production networks are highly automated and geographically flexible. Instead, a comprehensive strategy should center on workforce preparation (especially high-quality vocational and apprenticeship pathways), reentry and second-chance hiring, and local ecosystems that pair firms’ technology adoption with people-centered skill investment. We close with a 10-paper series plan to develop the agenda in detail.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了美国经济与公民生活的三大结构性力量：中国工业自动化加速、美国劳动力市场技能错配、以及大规模监禁问题。认为关税不足以解决产业回流和工资增长问题，提出应关注职业培训、再就业机会和本地创新生态系统的综合策略。
AI.research_question: 如何有效应对全球化供应链自动化、劳动力技能错配和大规模监禁对美国经济和社会结构的挑战？
AI.motivation: 识别并解决影响美国经济竞争力和社会流动性的关键结构性障碍，为制定更有效的产业和劳动力政策提供理论依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合全球化供应链理论、劳动力市场分割理论和人力资本理论，构建分析自动化、技能错配和监禁对经济影响的理论框架。
AI.method: 文献综述和证据综合方法，分析三大结构性力量的相互作用和影响机制。
AI.findings: 关税政策在高度自动化的全球生产网络中效果有限；需要综合性的劳动力准备、再就业支持和本地创新生态系统建设。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了整合自动化、技能错配和监禁问题的综合分析框架，拓展了产业政策和劳动力发展理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了包含职业培训、学徒制、再就业支持和本地技术-技能配对的具体政策建议，为政策制定者提供可操作方案。

title: A Utility-Based Framework for Integrating Biological and Environmental Influences
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: A Utility-Based Framework for Integrating Biological and Environmental Influences
detail.abstract: Although individuals are assumed to have many common motives in their utility functions (e.g., wealth/resources, safety/security) they nonetheless exhibit materially varying behaviors. This paper proposes a new model of utility maximization based on an individual's dynamic portfolio of "sub-utilities" each weighted as a function of the individual's genetic architecture, developmental history, evolutionary biases, and environmental feedback. Changes to utility over time are captured by a dynamic updating rule.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个新的效用最大化模型，基于个体动态的"子效用"组合，每个子效用权重由遗传结构、发展历史、进化偏见和环境反馈决定，并通过动态更新规则捕捉效用随时间的变化。
AI.research_question: 如何解释个体在具有共同效用动机的情况下仍表现出显著不同的行为？
AI.motivation: 虽然个体被认为在效用函数中有许多共同动机（如财富/资源、安全/保障），但他们却表现出实质性的行为差异，现有模型无法充分解释这种差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态子效用组合模型，将效用函数分解为多个子效用，每个子效用的权重由遗传架构、发展历史、进化偏见和环境反馈共同决定。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，提出基于动态子效用组合的效用最大化框架，包含权重函数和动态更新规则。
AI.findings: 提出的模型能够更好地解释个体行为差异，通过考虑多重因素对效用权重的影响，提供了更全面的行为解释框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了新的效用最大化理论，突破了传统单一效用函数的局限，引入了动态和多维度的效用结构。
AI.practical_contributions: 为行为经济学、决策科学和个性化政策设计提供了新的理论工具，有助于更好地理解和预测个体决策行为。

title: Entanglement, No-Signalling, and the Real Path to Quantum Advantage: Foundations, Architectures, and Societal Implications
affiliations: Independent researcher

detail.title: Entanglement, No-Signalling, and the Real Path to Quantum Advantage: Foundations, Architectures, and Societal Implications

declarations.ethicsApproval: No ethics

detail.abstract: Quantum computing promises computational capabilities unattainable by classical machines for specific problem classes. This paper lays out the physics that underpins those promises, distinguishes accurate claims from persistent misconceptions, and assesses credible impact pathways. We begin from first principles-superposition, entanglement, measurement, and interference-then explain why entanglement cannot transmit information on its own (the no-communication theorem). We survey hallmark protocols (teleportation, superdense coding) and algorithms (Shor, Grover, and selected linear-algebra primitives), and we confront the central engineering challengefault-tolerant error correction-emphasizing the surface code and recent experimental milestones. We outline the role of quantum networks (repeaters, entanglement distribution), clarify the relationship between quantum and classical channels, and conclude with societal implications: the cryptography transition is already underway at NIST, near-term quantum simulation prospects in chemistry and materials, and longerterm opportunities and limits in optimization and machine learning.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了量子计算的基本原理、关键技术进展和应用前景，区分了准确主张与常见误解，评估了可信的影响路径，涵盖了从物理基础到实际应用的完整框架。

detail.abstract: This review essay examines the intricate political and historical dynamics of the Jordan-Israel-Palestine triangle, focusing on the influences of elite decision-making, identity politics, and structural constraints from the British Mandate until the present. It analyzes how the British Mandate (1920-1948) served as a pivotal framework that set the stage for ongoing territorial and national tensions. The role of key figures, especially King Abdullah of Jordan, is emphasized in navigating complex relationships amid competing national aspirations. The document further discusses the evolution of Palestinian nationalism, the impact of post-1948 developments on regional stability, and the significance of inter-group relations. The analysis reveals that the triangles' enduring constants-elite negotiation, identity recognition, and strategic interdependence-remain critical in understanding the current and future prospects for Palestinian statehood, Jordanian diplomacy, and Israeli security. Ultimately, the study calls for a broader exploration of underexplored regional triangles to deepen the comprehension of multi-state interactions and contemporary conflict resolution efforts in the Middle East.

title: Expectations, Learning Gains, and Forecast Errors: Assessing Nonlinearities with a Functional Coefficient Approach
affiliations: University of California, Irvine - Department of Economics

detail.title: Expectations, Learning Gains, and Forecast Errors: Assessing Nonlinearities with a Functional Coefficient Approach

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper investigates potential nonlinearities in the gain function, which, under adaptive learning, regulates the updating of agents’ beliefs in response to recent forecast errors. I use data on professional survey forecasts to estimate nonparametric functional-coefficient regression models. The estimation results reveal nonlinearities in the relationships between expectations and forecast errors, which are indicative of nonlinear gain functions. Gains increase when forecast errors are historically large, and respond asymmetrically to past overpredictions and underpredictions. The findings suggest incorporating nonlinearities in the modeling of learning gains, instead of relying on the constant-gain assumption.

title: Robust Exchange
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley - Haas School of Business and The University of Osaka - Graduate School of Economics

detail.title: Robust Exchange
detail.abstract: This paper offers the first rigorous economic analysis of the dropout problem---a practical challenge in designing exchange markets. We introduce a model incorporating situations where participants may drop out of the market before transactions occur, which results in the failure of all transactions within the same exchange cycle. We show that the celebrated Top Trading Cycles (TTC) mechanism is disadvantaged due to its potential reliance on large exchange cycles, which implies a high likelihood of transaction defaults. Furthermore, agents may not have an incentive to truthfully report their preferences under the TTC mechanism when dropouts can happen. To improve efficiency, we propose k-greedy mechanisms designed to manage the risks associated with exchange cycle sizes while maintaining reasonable efficiency, with a constraint on the maximum possible cycle size of k. We show, both theoretically and through simulations, that the k-greedy mechanisms (with small values of k) outperform the TTC mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对交换市场中的退出问题进行了严格的经济学分析，提出了考虑参与者可能退出的模型，发现经典TTC机制因依赖大交换环而易受退出影响，并提出了限制环大小的k-greedy机制来提高效率。
AI.research_question: 如何在存在参与者退出风险的交换市场中设计有效的匹配机制？
AI.motivation: 实际交换市场中参与者可能在交易发生前退出，导致整个交换环的交易失败，这是一个重要的实践挑战但缺乏理论分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于交换市场理论和匹配理论，特别是Top Trading Cycles (TTC)机制的理论基础。
AI.method: 理论建模分析结合数值模拟，比较TTC机制和提出的k-greedy机制在不同退出概率下的表现。
AI.findings: TTC机制因依赖大交换环而容易受到退出影响，参与者可能没有激励真实报告偏好；k-greedy机制（k值较小时）在理论和模拟中都优于TTC机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将退出风险纳入交换市场理论分析，提出了新的机制设计框架，扩展了匹配理论的应用范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实际交换市场设计提供了实用的机制选择，通过限制交换环大小来管理退出风险，提高市场运行的稳健性。

title: Intellectual Capital Money: A Novel Global Reserve Anchored in Intellectual Value
affiliations: Independent researcher

detail.title: Intellectual Capital Money: A Novel Global Reserve Anchored in Intellectual Value
detail.abstract: This paper introduces a novel monetary architecture centered on Intellectual Capital Money (IKM) — a borderless fiat virtual currency issued when intellectual capital is licensed.  Structured through a balance sheet framework, this mechanism enhances access to protected intellectual capital while safeguarding the private rights of its holders.  Chapter 1 outlines the institutional design: central banks fund intellectual capital licenses by issuing IKM in exchange for interest-bearing government securities.  Chapter 2 demonstrates that, unlike conventional monetary injections, IKM funding boosts economic output by fostering intellectual capital accumulation without inducing inflation — positioning it as a policy instrument for combating stagflation.  Chapter 3 extends the framework to an open economy by introducing the International Reserve Asset (RA) Market, where IKM functions as a liquid global reserve asset.  This framework resolves the international monetary trilemma by enabling autonomous monetary policy without compromising exchange rate stability or capital mobility.  Chapter 4 presents a model of the intellectual capital economy (IK economy), revealing that IKM funding functions as a loan backed by national assets, facilitating intertemporal trade under a budget constraint defined by interest rates and asset exchange rates.  Altogether, IKM redefines the governance of intellectual capital — shifting the paradigm from exclusion to productive access — and is grounded in a core insight: money and intellectual capital are fundamentally equivalent as generative foundations of economic value.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于知识产权货币（IKM）的新型货币架构，通过资产负债表框架发行无国界虚拟货币来促进知识产权积累，既能刺激经济增长又不会引发通胀，同时解决国际货币三难困境。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种基于知识产权的新型货币体系，既能促进经济增长又不引发通胀，同时解决国际货币政策自主性、汇率稳定和资本流动性的三难困境？
AI.motivation: 传统货币政策在刺激经济时往往伴随通胀风险，且国际货币体系存在三难困境，需要一种新的货币架构来更好地管理知识产权并促进经济稳定增长。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资产负债表框架的货币发行理论，知识产权经济学理论，国际货币三难困境理论，以及货币与知识产权作为经济价值生成基础等价性的核心洞察。
AI.method: 理论建模和制度设计方法，包括：1）IKM制度设计；2）封闭经济下的宏观经济分析；3）开放经济下的国际储备资产市场设计；4）知识产权经济模型构建。
AI.findings: 1）IKM融资能促进知识产权积累并提高经济产出而不引发通胀；2）IKM作为全球储备资产能解决国际货币三难困境；3）IKM融资本质上是基于国家资产担保的贷款，在利率和资产汇率约束下促进跨期交易。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了知识产权货币的新理论框架，建立了货币与知识产权等价性的理论基础，为解决货币政策与知识产权管理的融合提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行提供了对抗滞胀的新政策工具，为国际货币体系改革提供了可行方案，为知识产权的高效利用和价值实现提供了新的金融基础设施。

detail.abstract: We analyze whether men and women respond differently to tuition variation for both university entry and STEM major choice, using a 30-year Australian individual-level administrative dataset. The Australian setting is unique: tuition fees are regulated, students can defer payment through income-contingent loans, and universities receive discipline-specific government subsidies. We find women consistently enrolled at higher rates than men, on average 14 percentage points between 1991 and 2020, with the gap widening over the period from 10 to 16 percentage points. By contrast, men were more likely to register in STEM fields. This STEM gap has remained stable in traditional STEM disciplines, but the gap has narrowed since 2005 when including Health in the definition of STEM. We find that women respond more positively than men to tuition increases in terms of overall enrollment. Effects on STEM participation, however, are less clear and vary across time. The STEM choice patterns suggest systematic gender differences in incentives and behavior, reflecting factors such as men’s stronger engagement with higher-paying non-university jobs, higher expected returns to traditional STEM fields for men, narrower earnings dispersion for women across fields, and gender differences in cost sensitivity and risk aversion. Our findings highlight how tuition policy interacts with gender-specific incentives to shape both university enrollment and major choices.

title: Invisible Banking: How Embedded Finance will Erase Traditional Banks
affiliations: THE DOON SCHOOL

detail.title: Invisible Banking: How Embedded Finance will Erase Traditional Banks
detail.abstract: Embedded finance refers to the seamless integration of financial services-payments, lending, insurance, and more-into the products and platforms of non-financial companies. In practice this means that consumers obtain financial services in the context of everyday activities (for example shopping, ride-sharing, or payroll) rather than by going to a bank or finance app. By "bringing banking to the customer" in context, embedded finance makes banking essentially invisible-the bank is just a back-end utility while the customer interacts with a retailer, platform or app. Indeed, as one expert notes, "the financial system of the future won't be built in banksit'll be embedded in the apps, platforms and services people already use". This paper examines the rise of embedded finance: defining the concept and its evolution, surveying key use cases (such as Amazon, Shopify, Uber, Apple Pay, and others), analyzing impacts on traditional banks and customer relationships, considering regulatory and security issues, describing technological enablers (APIs, Banking-as-a-Service, fintech partnerships), and exploring remaining challenges and future trends in financial intermediation. The overall thesis is that as embedded finance proliferates, banking will recede from view and traditional banks will increasingly serve as invisible infrastructure providers.

detail.abstract: It generally assumed that a steady and straightforward inflation rate fuels the economic progress of a nation. Moderate price increases help consumers, intensify investment and consequently boost the country's financial development. This project measures the impact of Inflation on Bangladesh's economic growth for 1987 – 2022 and using the regression analysis, ADF Unit-root test (trend regress and drift regress), ARDL Bounds test, Cointegration method framework and studies the long and short-run relationship between economic growth and inflation. ARDL approach used for the analysis of the short-run relationship between Economic growth and inflation. Also, the outcomes show a connection between economic growth and Inflation in Bangladesh's context in the long run. Results confirm that we can expect the future action of the GDP growth by examining inflation trends.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过回归分析、ADF单位根检验、ARDL边界检验和协整方法，分析了1987-2022年间通货膨胀对孟加拉国经济增长的影响，发现两者存在长期关联性，通胀趋势可预测GDP增长。

detail.abstract: Embedded Finance and Banking-as-a-Service (BaaS) are transforming financial services by unbundling banking into modular, API-driven ecosystems. This paper introduces the Modular Financial Resilience Theory (MFRT), which posits that BaaS ecosystems generate systemic vulnerabilities comparable to network cascades in complex systems. These risks can be mitigated by adaptive interoperability standards that enhance crisis resilience and reduce financial inequality. The study integrates a systematic literature review (2015-2025), industry case studies, regulatory analysis, and original empirical research using large-scale simulations and econometric models, including regression discontinuity and instrumental variables. The contributions are sixfold: (a) formalized definitions of embedded finance and BaaS; (b) comparative analyses across global implementations; (c) a game-theoretic revenue-sharing model with Nash equilibria; (d) stochastic differential equations modeling monetization volatility in imperfect markets; (e) an open-source BaaS simulation platform for compliance testing; and (f) a policy blueprint for a Global BaaS Harmonization Protocol. Cross-disciplinary methods adapted from public health and network science are applied to model "BaaS epidemiology," quantifying effects on inclusion and systemic risk. Findings confirm scalability and inclusion benefits but highlight compliance and systemic vulnerabilities, underscoring the need for ethical governance. The work reframes finance as an adaptive ecosystem, informs policy revisions such as PSD2, and establishes a foundation for resilient fintech innovation.

detail.abstract: The comparison of gold and silver prices in India is a significant topic that reflects the broader economic, cultural, and geopolitical dynamics affecting the country. Gold and silver have long been considered vital assets for Indian investors, deeply rooted in tradition and investment strategies. In recent years, the interplay between these two precious metals has garnered attention due to their fluctuating prices, influenced by global economic conditions, supply and demand dynamics, and cultural factors. Understanding these trends is crucial for investors, policymakers, and the general public as they navigate the complexities of the bullion market in India. Notably, the prices of gold and silver in India have shown remarkable volatility, with shifts often mirroring global market trends and domestic economic conditions.

detail.abstract: Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) delivery is ultimately a financing and governance challenge. This article argues that financial transparency-anchored in robust AML-CFT systems-is the precondition for effective SDG implementation, especially in the Global South. Drawing on FATF standards (Recommendations and Immediate Outcomes), the IMF Fiscal Transparency Code, and evidence from public-expenditure tracking, the paper shows how leakages, corruption, and illicit financial flows bleed funds away from health, education, climate, and social protection. It proposes a Transparency-First SDG Delivery (TSDG) framework that links each SDG program to time-bound sub-targets, standard data schemas, third-party verification, beneficial-ownership transparency, and open-budget procurement trails. The framework is illustrated with lessons from Pakistan's reform experience, underscoring how transparency-first design can accelerate SDG delivery in practice. The paper includes an implementation roadmap and measurable indicators that governments, donors, and civil society can operationalize within one budget cycle.

title: US Multinational Production and the Global Financial Cycle
affiliations: Northwestern University, Kellogg School of Management

detail.title: US Multinational Production and the Global Financial Cycle
detail.abstract: This paper investigates cross-sectional dynamics associated with the transmission of US fiscal policy shocks into global asset prices. Contrary to traditional international trade theories, notions of distance (geographical, cultural or institutional) are not the driving factor. Rather, I find that these patterns are more pronounced for countries that have deeper US multinational (MNC) presence. To explain these striking results, I build a quantitative multi-country endogenous growth model in which U.S. MNCs deploy R&D abroad and fiscal policy dynamics interact with innovation. The model qualitatively and quantitatively reproduces the cross-sectional and time-series patterns of fiscal transmission into global asset prices and delivers testable predictions confirmed in the data.

detail.title: The IRS’ Authority to Seize Assets in Foreign Jurisdictions to Satisfy FBAR Penalties
detail.abstract: In this article, Brackney and Ryan discuss the Internal Revenue Service’s (IRS’) ability to seize offshore assets to collect delinquent Report of Foreign Bank and Financial Accounts (FBAR) penalties. On May 12, 2021, Thomas J. Sawyer of the U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) Tax Division opined that the United States was likely to see a dramatic increase in repatriation orders as the IRS focuses its collection efforts on pursuing international assets.1 “It hinges on jurisdiction over the taxpayer or the person controlling the property,” Sawyer explained.2 “[O]nce we get that jurisdiction, the court has broad authority to order repatriation. … The standards are really not that demanding.”3 Repatriation orders are one of the many tools available to the IRS to obtain money owed by delinquent taxpayers, and it appears the IRS is making good on Sawyer’s prediction and will use repatriation orders as the Service’s primary means of seizing assets held overseas. As discussed below, this will have the most profound effects on taxpayers with assets abroad, who refuse to pay their FBAR penalties, and over whom courts in the United States have personal jurisdiction.

detail.abstract: This paper examines the evolution, theoretical rationale, and effectiveness of nicotine-control policies in Australia and New Zealand. Using historical policy reviews, economic theory and econometric modelling, the paper evaluates the role of excise taxation, non-price tobacco controls and reduced-risk alternatives such as vaping in reducing smoking prevalence. The analysis employs a state-space autoregressive framework to isolate the contributions of price, vaping, and other controls to declines in smoking rates from 1980 (Australia) and 1983 (New Zealand) through to 2023. Findings indicate that real cigarette price increases account for much of the observed decline in smoking rates, with vaping contributing significantly in New Zealand but insignificantly in Australia where access to vapes was more restricted. The paper also assesses the public health implications of smoking, the potential benefits and risks of harm-reduced alternatives, and the distributional consequences of nicotine internalities. Policy recommendations emphasise proportional regulation, targeted excise structures and integration of harm reduction into tobacco-control frameworks.

detail.abstract: This chapter examines the phenomenon of sexual corruption, where access to public services is conditioned on sexualized compliance. Sexual corruption, which predominantly targets women, imposes a unique violation of personal dignity and autonomy, leaving victims with few avenues for redress due to stigma, institutional disbelief, and fear of retaliation. Drawing on qualitative data from focus groups with women engaged in Brazil's public healthcare system, the chapter explores how sexual corruption operates not as isolated misconduct, but as a structural condition embedded in everyday service delivery. Sexual corruption is shown to thrive across multiple sectorsincluding healthcare, law enforcement, and education-facilitated by systemic impunity and discretionary institutional cultures. Sexual corruption disproportionately affects women from lower-income or peripheral areas, who are perceived as less informed or less protected. The chapter argues for reframing sexual corruption as both a failure of governance and a critical gender justice issue. This framing enables the development of effective anti-corruption policies that move beyond individual punishment to address the institutional cultures that allow sexual corruption to persist.

detail.abstract: This paper is a response to and offers supporting analysis for Gary Stevenson's (and Thomas Piketti's) claim that only rigorous Government intervention can slow the pace of the otherwise ineluctable growth in wealth inequality,which,if left unchecked is likely to have catastrophic consequences for society. The paper shows analytically through simulation that an unequal distribution of wealth (typically the norm in industrial or post industrial society) according to the Pareto curve will, over time, lead to further massive inequalities od wealth. However a small redistribution of wealth from the very richest will have the effect of slowing inequality growth. The simulation analysis is supported by an analysis of wealth inequality growth in the USA and UK between 1950 and 2020. The paper concludes with briefly reviewing the celebrated an analysis of Piketti which tells a similar story by different means

AI.tldr: 本文通过模拟分析和实证数据支持Stevenson和Piketti的观点，证明财富不平等会自我强化，只有政府干预才能减缓不平等加剧的趋势。

AI.method: 模拟分析（基于帕累托曲线的财富分布动态模拟）和实证分析（1950-2020年美英两国财富不平等数据）
AI.findings: 财富不平等确实会自我强化增长；对最富有人群的小规模财富再分配能有效减缓不平等加剧
AI.theory_contributions: 为财富不平等自我强化理论提供模拟验证，支持政府干预的必要性理论

title: Agile by Adaptive Design: An Algorithm for Decentralized Trials
affiliations: The University of Sydney

detail.title: Agile by Adaptive Design: An Algorithm for Decentralized Trials
detail.abstract: Decentralized Clinical Trials (DCTs) represent a significant advancement in clinical research, offering greater accessibility, flexibility, and participant engagement through the use of telemedicine, mobile health technologies, and remote data capture. However, the decentralized nature of data collection introduces challenges related to data reliability and variability, which are often inadequately addressed by conventional statistical methods at the design stage of the trial.This study presents an agile Bayesian design framework tailored to the specific needs of DCTs, integrating adaptive data reliability directly into trial design and analysis. Our approach is based on Bayesian decision rules to guide interim sample size adjustments. By treating data reliability as a model parameter rather than an external factor, our method accounts for uncertainty and improves the robustness of power calculations.Simulation studies demonstrate the effectiveness of this strategy. The proposed framework enables a flexible and agile approach to DCT design that can adapt to varying data quality conditions. This work offers a foundation for extending the proposed adaptive method to other trial contexts, including time-to-event endpoints, and supports the broader adoption of DCTs in real-world clinical research.

detail.abstract: The piece analyzes the geopolitical, environmental, and economic complexities of the Red Sea region, aiming to advocate for enhanced cooperation among regional countries and external powers to foster sustainable development and stability. It seeks to address the research question of how cross-border collaboration and integrated development strategies can improve security, economic growth, and environmental sustainability in the region. Using a qualitative approach, the analysis reviews existing literature, case studies, and comparative scenarios to evaluate current dynamics, potential governance frameworks, and the roles of various actors, including the European Union, Gulf States, and local governments. The findings reveal that regional states face significant challenges, such as political instability, economic fragmentation, and environmental degradation, which necessitate coordinated responses. Key drivers for attracting foreign investment and boosting intra-regional trade include the establishment of Special Economic Zones and modernization of infrastructure. Additionally, the potential of cultural diplomacy and transregional engagement remains underutilized but is crucial for fostering trust and collaboration among nations. The role of external powers, such as the EU and US, is recognized as both supportive and complex due to competing interests. In conclusion, the document emphasizes that the future of the Red Sea region relies on the ability of stakeholders to move beyond traditional rivalries towards collaborative frameworks that prioritize inclusivity and sustainability. By integrating governance efforts focused on economic, environmental, and security objectives, stakeholders can create a stable and prosperous Red Sea capable of addressing both current challenges and future opportunities. Proactive engagement, institutional strengthening, and innovative cooperation mechanisms are essential to realizing this vision.

detail.title: Predatory Litigation in the Health Sector: Competition Challenges of Judicial Activism in Brazil

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors are practicing competition lawyers in Brazil, with both practical and academic experience in the field, having served as regulators and private practitioners. The identification of the issue addressed in this research stems from this professional and academic background. Both authors have worked on cases in the healthcare sector, which contributed to a more comprehensive and well-founded analysis, without compromising impartiality. publicationDetails.detailsText: GW Competition and Innovation Lab | August 2025

detail.abstract: Predatory litigation has become increasingly prevalent in Brazil’s health and pharmaceutical markets, serving as a mechanism to delay the entry of generics, extend patent monopolies, and inflate healthcare costs. In 2024, Brazilian courts recorded 154,857 new lawsuits related to hospital treatments, with São Paulo accounting for 37% of these cases. Additionally, legal expenses for private insurers surged by 37.6% in 2023, reaching BRL 5.5 billion, highlighting significant competitive and public health concerns. This study seeks to address the question: “To what extent do predatory litigation and judicial activism impair competition in Brazil’s health and pharmaceutical sectors, and what measures can mitigate these effects?” It posits that the absence of binding criteria for identifying predatory practices, coupled with limited judicial expertise in competition and regulation, enables the courts' systematic misuse. By referencing the U.S. Noerr-Pennington doctrine, its sham-litigation exception, and related tests (such as PRE, POSCO, and fraudulent litigation), this research contrasts doctrinal protections against baseless lawsuits with practices including evergreening, patent thickets, and trademark misuse. Employing a convergent mixed-methods design, the study integrates: (a) a systematic review of literature, judicial statistics, and precedents; (b) quantitative analysis of a variety of cases from the Brazilian judiciary, focusing on the volume of lawsuits, their duration, and financial repercussions; and (c) qualitative case studies and semi-structured interviews with judges, lawyers, economists, and regulators. The synthesis of these findings aims to quantify economic damage, identify procedural bottlenecks, and offer evidence-based recommendations for regulators, competition authorities, and legislators to combat predatory litigation and promote accessible, innovative healthcare.

title: Critical Minerals, Critical Choices: Zimbabwe's Lithium Sector and the Quest for Inclusive Development
affiliations: and Nicholls State University

detail.title: Critical Minerals, Critical Choices: Zimbabwe's Lithium Sector and the Quest for Inclusive Development
detail.abstract: This article examines the rapid expansion of Zimbabwe's lithium sector in the context of the global energy transition and rising demand for critical raw materials (CRMs). Positioned as Africa's most lithium-rich country and among the top five globally, Zimbabwe is strategically placed to benefit from surging international interest in battery minerals. Drawing on empirical fieldwork, semi-structured interviews, and policy analysis, this study interrogates whether the country's lithium boom can serve as a foundation for inclusive, sustainable development, or whether it risks reinforcing extractive dependency and elite capture. Findings reveal that while foreign investment-especially from Chinese firms-has significantly increased, it has not translated into broad-based economic transformation. Employment gains are evident but are accompanied by exploitative labor practices and minimal community benefits. Moreover, the sector is plagued by weak regulatory enforcement, corruption, and limited beneficiation capacity, undermining Zimbabwe's aspirations under its Vision 2030 and National Development Strategy 1 (NDS1). The article argues for a paradigm shift in resource governance: from one centered on raw material export to one anchored in industrial policy, value addition, and institutional reform. Recommendations include transparent licensing regimes, regional CRM value chain integration, and targeted investment in refining infrastructure. Zimbabwe stands at a pivotal moment; the decisions made today regarding lithium governance will profoundly shape the country's economic trajectory for decades to come.

detail.title: The Efficiency of Ensuring the Financial Security of Armenia։ New Approaches
detail.abstract: Financial security is considered a subsystem of the economic security system. The financial security of the Republic of Armenia is one of the most urgent issues of study and analysis. Covid-19 and the 2020 war in Armenia harmed all sectors of the Armenian economy, especially economic and financial security. At this moment, the research of the chosen topic becomes more than necessary and urgent. In the current postcrisis period, financial security is more than possible in Armenia. In this article, we tried to define and analyze the elements affecting the security of the Armenian financial system and evaluate the current effectiveness of financial security. For that purpose, we have formulated the following research questions: How are countries' financial security assessed? What elements ensure financial security in Armenia? Is the current system of financial security effective in Armenia? The applied methodologies are quantitative and qualitative. In particular, we used index analysis, graphical analysis, comparison, and expert evaluation analysis to answer the research questions. The analysis results showed that the change of isolated factors significantly impacts indicators of the country's economy, particularly the financial system; moreover, the factors indirectly impact the country's social, political, and public life.

title: Levees And Levies: Local Financing of Climate Infrastructure Maintenance and Housing Market Dynamics

detail.title: Levees And Levies: Local Financing of Climate Infrastructure Maintenance and Housing Market Dynamics
detail.abstract: Local financing of climate infrastructure structurally connects infrastructure quality with housing value through property tax revenue. I study how this connection shapes the long-term dynamics of neighborhood housing value and climate risk. Using novel data on U.S. flood protection levees, I show that lower-income neighborhoods are disproportionately behind levees of maintenance deficiencies, leading to higher levee failure risk. Exploiting exogenous shocks to local economic conditions and levee failures, I find that weaker housing markets degrade levee maintenance, while levee failures in turn reduce housing values and local revenues. These bi-directional dynamics reinforce a feedback loop of fiscal stress and climate vulnerability, contributing to underinvestment in infrastructure with positive net benefits.

detail.abstract: This paper evaluates the growing role of big technology companies in the banking sector and the opportunities and risks they present. It traces the evolution of banking to the digital era, highlighting how firms such as Google, Amazon, and Alibaba are reshaping payments, lending, wealth management, and insurance. With focus on India and its global parallels, it assesses regulatory responses from the RBI, SEBI, and CCI alongside international frameworks. The paper argues that while big tech fosters innovation and financial inclusion, it also demands adaptive regulation to safeguard competition, consumer protection, and systemic stability in an evolving financial ecosystem.

AI.findings: 大型科技公司推动了支付、借贷、财富管理和保险等领域的创新，促进了金融包容性，但同时也带来了竞争担忧、消费者保护问题和系统性风险。
