AI.motivation: 探讨AI在企业创新中的复杂作用，超越简单的效率提升视角
AI.theoretical_framework: 创新披露理论、战略信息披露理论、AI驱动的创新理论
AI.method: 使用2014-2022年中国上市公司434,493个发明-专利-年度观测值的综合数据集进行实证分析
AI.findings: 更大的AI投资与显著更长的创新披露期相关；AI帮助企业深化专业领域专长；AI驱动创新的高质量和复杂性需要更长时间审查；企业策略性延长披露以保持技术优势；在市场压力大、制度障碍低、技术障碍低时披露期更长
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了AI在创新中的复杂战略作用，挑战了AI仅提升效率的传统观点
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业AI投资决策提供新视角，帮助理解AI如何影响创新流程和时间管理

title: Quantifying the Emotional Value of Goods and Services: Values of Hate and Love and Everything in Between
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Quantifying the Emotional Value of Goods and Services: Values of Hate and Love and Everything in Between
detail.abstract: Conventional economic analysis treats goods and services as bundles of functional attributes whose value is revealed by prices and choices. Yet real-world demand is pervasively shaped by feelings-joy, disgust, pride, nostalgia, envy, comfort, belonging. This paper formalizes emotional value as a measurable component of consumer welfare, distinct from (but interacting with) functional utility and monetary cost. Building on affective science, neuro-economics, marketing, and information systems, I propose a composite Emotional Value Index (EVI) that integrates (i) self-report psychometrics, (ii) linguistic and behavioral traces, (iii) psychophysiology (e.g., HRV, EDA, pupil and gaze), (iv) neural evidence, and (v) digital footprints (search, clickstreams, reviews). The paper details measurement, validation, and computation of EVI, including methods to infer affect from online data rather than questionnaires alone. I illustrate applications for platform firms (Google/YouTube, Amazon, Apple, Netflix), discuss how love (positive valence, high identity alignment) and hate (negative valence, high arousal/identity threat) sit at opposite poles of an affect space, and show how EVI can slot into cost-benefit analysis, hedonic pricing, discrete-choice models, and computable general equilibrium. I conclude with a governance blueprint (privacy law, dark-pattern avoidance, differential privacy) for ethically harnessing emotion. The approach reframes "value" to include how goods make us feel, not just what they do.

AI.tldr: 本文提出情感价值指数(EVI)作为消费者福利的可测量组成部分，将情感价值正式纳入经济分析框架，整合多种测量方法，并探讨其在平台企业和政策制定中的应用。
AI.research_question: 如何将情感价值作为可测量的消费者福利组成部分纳入经济分析框架？
AI.motivation: 传统经济分析仅关注商品的功能属性和价格，但现实需求普遍受到情感因素（喜悦、厌恶、自豪、怀旧等）的影响，需要建立情感价值的正式测量方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于情感科学、神经经济学、市场营销和信息系统的理论框架，将情感价值视为与功能效用和货币成本相区别但互动的消费者福利组成部分。
AI.method: 提出复合情感价值指数(EVI)，整合五种测量方法：自我报告心理测量、语言和行为痕迹、心理生理学测量、神经证据、数字足迹分析。
AI.findings: 情感价值是可测量的消费者福利维度，爱（积极效价、高身份一致性）和恨（消极效价、高唤醒/身份威胁）位于情感空间的两极，EVI可融入成本效益分析等经济模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 将情感价值正式纳入经济分析框架，拓展了传统价值概念，建立了情感价值的测量理论和方法论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台企业（Google、Amazon等）提供情感价值测量工具，提出治理蓝图（隐私法律、暗模式避免、差分隐私）以实现情感数据的道德利用。

title: Does patient capital enhance supply chain resilience in manufacturing enterprises? Evidence from China’s Listed Companies
affiliations: Changzhou University and Changzhou University

detail.title: Does patient capital enhance supply chain resilience in manufacturing enterprises? Evidence from China’s Listed Companies
detail.abstract: Enhancing supply chain resilience (SCR) in manufacturing enterprises through patient capital (PCR) is crucial for improving industrial security in the manufacturing sector. This study examines whether patient capital (PCR) enhances SCR, analyzing panel data from Chinese listed companies between 2013 and 2024. Empirical results indicate that PCR significantly improves SCR, with robust effects across both dimensions—resistance and recovery. Mechanism analysis indicates that financing constraints, human capital, and corporate innovation are key channels through which PCR promotes SCR. Heterogeneity analysis further reveals that PCR's positive impact is more pronounced in family-owned enterprises, high-tech firms, and companies located in regions with higher marketization levels. These findings provide timely empirical evidence for cultivating supply chain resilience in manufacturing enterprises through patient capital.

title: Health Sector Problems in Bangladesh: Developing a Management Point of View
affiliations: Chittagong Independent University

detail.title: Health Sector Problems in Bangladesh: Developing a Management Point of View

declarations.declarationOfInterest: not applicable
declarations.ethicsApproval: not applicable

detail.abstract: Purpose: This paper aims to critically examine the persistent service delivery failures in Bangladesh's health sector through a management lens, against the popular claim of budget shortage or inadequate resource allocation. Research Design: A multi-method qualitative design was employed, combining media content analysis, field visits, and citizen interviews. Data were gathered in two phases (2009-12 and 2021-24) to reveal recurring patterns. The study uses ethnographic observation, narrative inquiry, and analytical narratives to understand the nature and depth of management failures in the public health system. Findings: The longitudinal findings over more than ten years reveal widespread inefficiencies including chronic vacancies, mismatched deployment of health professionals and equipment, non-functional logistics, absenteeism, regulatory failures, and broken accountability mechanisms. These issues are not isolated incidents but recurrent patterns spanning over a decade. They illustrate that despite physical and infrastructural progress, service delivery remains undermined by the absence of strategic HR planning, weak operational systems, and poor governance. Contribution: The study underscores the need for a managerial transformation in public health governance. Based on health sector case, it contributes to the literature on public sector management in developing countries by emphasizing the importance of management capability over mere resource infusion.

AI.tldr: 本文通过管理视角批判性分析孟加拉国卫生部门持续的服务交付失败问题，研究发现管理能力缺失而非预算不足是根本原因

title: Groups as Resonance: Semantic Markers, Self-Observation, and Collective Intelligence
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Groups as Resonance: Semantic Markers, Self-Observation, and Collective Intelligence
detail.abstract: This paper introduces groups as a distinct form of social coordination operating through resonance—the recursive amplification of observed communication patterns. While existing theory recognizes interaction (requiring co-presence) and organization (requiring formal structure), groups persist through neither, maintaining identity and coordination through what we term "semantic markers"—communicative condensations that temporarily stabilize meaning under conditions of uncertainty. Drawing on second-order cybernetics and autopoietic theory, we demonstrate how groups achieve emotional coordination without direct emotional transmission. Through five-level transformation processes, emotional patterns become observable, these observations become communicable, and repeated communications crystallize into semantic markers. These markers perform a triple function: simultaneously stabilizing complexity, enabling variation, and coupling individual consciousness without merger. Field observations from basketball teams and organizational settings illustrate how groups self-organize through "structured openness"—maintaining sufficient structure for coherence while preserving flexibility for adaptation. The Triangle Offense in basketball exemplifies this principle: spatial structures enable rather than determine decisions, with coordination emerging through mutual observation rather than central control. Groups constitute themselves through observing their own observations, creating what we identify as resonance fields. These fields exist only as long as self-observation continues; when it ceases, the group dissolves, though individuals remain. This distinguishes groups fundamentally from organizations, which persist through formal structures even without active engagement. The framework generates testable predictions about group behavior, semantic innovation, and structural transformation, while acknowledging unresolved questions regarding scale, power dynamics, and cultural variation. Understanding groups as resonance phenomena reveals them not as deficient organizations or extended interactions, but as the fundamental mechanism through which humans create collective intelligence and navigate uncertainty without central control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出群体是一种通过共振实现社会协调的独特形式，群体通过语义标记在不确定性条件下维持身份认同和协调，而不需要共同在场或正式组织结构。
AI.research_question: 群体如何在不需要共同在场或正式组织结构的情况下，通过共振机制实现社会协调和身份维持？
AI.motivation: 现有理论主要关注互动（需要共同在场）和组织（需要正式结构），但忽略了群体这种既不需要共同在场也不需要正式结构却能维持协调的社会形式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于二阶控制论和自创生理论，提出群体通过语义标记和共振场实现协调的理论框架。
AI.method: 理论构建结合篮球团队和组织环境的实地观察，特别是三角进攻战术的分析。
AI.findings: 群体通过五级转化过程实现情感协调：情感模式可观察化→观察可沟通化→沟通结晶为语义标记。语义标记具有三重功能：稳定复杂性、实现变异、耦合个体意识。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了群体作为共振现象的新理论框架，区分了群体与组织的本质差异，揭示了群体通过自我观察维持存在的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解团队协调、组织设计和集体智能提供了新视角，特别是在不确定环境下如何实现无中心控制的协调。

title: Managing Virtual Sales Teams: Challenges and Evidence-Based Recommendations
affiliations: Ohio University and Independent

detail.title: Managing Virtual Sales Teams: Challenges and Evidence-Based Recommendations

declarations.declarationOfInterest: none
declarations.ethicsApproval: review article, no ethics review needed

detail.abstract: Virtual sales teams face a host of challenges due to the difficulties inherent to collaborating virtually. We highlight four of these challenges – communication, coordination, trust, and team composition – and offer recommendations about how virtual sales teams can overcome each. Drawing upon the research focusing on sales teams and virtual teams can provide virtual sales team leaders with evidence-based solutions to these and other challenges. Although virtual sales teams have already been increasing in prevalence, the recent global COVID pandemic has fueled the trend toward working remotely in all fields, including sales. As a result, more and more sales teams will likely be operating virtually in the future. We encourage virtual sales team leaders to be aware of the challenges these teams face and to take the necessary steps to help them overcome them and succeed.

AI.tldr: 虚拟销售团队面临沟通、协调、信任和团队构成四大挑战，本文基于销售团队和虚拟团队研究提出应对建议，帮助团队领导在远程工作趋势下有效管理团队。
AI.research_question: 虚拟销售团队面临哪些主要挑战以及如何克服这些挑战？
AI.motivation: 随着COVID-19疫情推动远程工作趋势，虚拟销售团队日益普遍，但面临独特的协作困难，需要研究提供解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于销售团队管理和虚拟团队协作的相关理论研究
AI.method: 文献综述和分析方法，整合销售团队和虚拟团队研究领域的现有证据
AI.findings: 识别出虚拟销售团队的四大核心挑战：沟通困难、协调问题、信任建立和团队构成优化
AI.theory_contributions: 将销售团队理论与虚拟团队理论相结合，为虚拟销售团队管理提供理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为虚拟销售团队领导者提供基于证据的具体建议，帮助克服远程协作挑战，提升团队绩效

affiliations: Visva-Bharati, Asian Development Bank - Economic Research, Asian Development Bank - Economic Research and Asian Development Bank

detail.title: Digitalization and Employment: Lessons from Developed and Developing Economies

publicationDetails.detailsText: ADB Economics Working Paper Series No. 802
publicationDetails.journalName: ADB Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This study examines the comparative effects of digitalization on employment in developed and developing economies. Based on available data from the International Labour Organization (2024), the International Telecommunication Union (2024), and the World Bank (2024), 3 different panels have been formed for the period 2000–2023 for the empirical exercises, which use panel data econometric methods. These panels comprise 53 developed economies, 74 developing economies, and 37 developing economies in Asia and the Pacific. The empirical results imply that the employment effect of digitalization across developed and developing economies is diverse. It is observed that the impact of digitalization on employment in developed economies is nonlinear (inverted-U), indicating that the initial effect is positive but that, in the long run, it tends to be negative. However, the impact of digitalization on employment is found to be positive and linear in groups of developing economies and developing Asian economies. More interestingly, compared to the group of global developing economies selected, the extent of the employment impact of digitalization is lesser in developing Asia and the Pacific. In this regard, the relationship between digitalization and job quality may play a pivotal role: past studies evidence that this relationship is crucial in determining whether digitalization leads to job creation or job loss. Brief policy lessons are also discussed based on the study findings.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较了数字化对发达和发展中经济体就业的影响差异，发现发达经济体呈倒U型非线性影响，而发展中经济体呈正向线性影响，且亚太发展中地区影响程度相对较小。
AI.research_question: 数字化对发达经济体和发展中经济体的就业影响有何差异？
AI.motivation: 探讨数字化进程对不同经济发展水平国家就业的差异化影响，为政策制定提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于数字化与就业关系的理论框架，考虑不同经济发展阶段的调节作用。
AI.method: 使用国际劳工组织、国际电信联盟和世界银行2000-2023年数据，构建53个发达经济体、74个发展中经济体和37个亚太发展中经济体三个面板，采用面板数据计量经济学方法。
AI.findings: 发达经济体数字化对就业呈倒U型非线性影响（先正后负），发展中经济体和亚太发展中经济体呈正向线性影响，且亚太地区影响程度相对较小。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了数字化就业影响的经济发展阶段异质性，丰富了数字化经济理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为不同发展阶段经济体制定差异化数字化就业政策提供实证参考，强调就业质量在数字化影响中的关键作用。

title: Global Events Demand Global Data: COVID-19 Crisis Responses and the Future of Selling and Sales Management Around the Globe

detail.title: Global Events Demand Global Data: COVID-19 Crisis Responses and the Future of Selling and Sales Management Around the Globe

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of International Marketing, volume 33, issue 2, 2025[10.1177/1069031X241282431]

detail.abstract: In the context of the global crisis presented by the COVID-19 pandemic, we investigate the perspectives of sales managers regarding their organizations' responses to the crisis and future expectations in a post-COVID-19 world. While there has been much discussion about these topics in the sales literature, very little research has examined them globally by collecting data from many nations and across many continents. Yet, how can global events be understood in the absence of global data? In response, we conducted the first, to our knowledge, global data coalition by hosting video-recorded group interviews with 76 sales executives representing twenty-seven nations. Our inductive investigation, informed by institutional logics, reveals how organizations accepted new norms, retained old ones, or blended the old with the new in response to the crisis. Our results simultaneously validate certain emerging concepts on a global scale (e.g., Customer Success Management, bricolage, etc.) and give rise to several insights not currently detailed by extant scholarship (e.g., localization, cultural cringe, etc.). This work also catalyzes new, relevant avenues for international research and sheds light on issues facing sales practice globally.

AI.tldr: 本文通过全球27个国家76位销售经理的视频记录组访谈，研究了销售组织在COVID-19危机中的应对策略和未来期望，揭示了组织如何接纳新规范、保留旧规范或融合新旧的组织逻辑。
AI.research_question: 销售组织如何应对COVID-19大流行危机？他们对后疫情时代有何期望？
AI.motivation: 虽然销售文献中有许多关于危机应对的讨论，但缺乏基于全球多国数据的研究，而全球性事件需要全球数据来理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度逻辑理论，研究组织如何接纳新规范、保留旧规范或融合新旧的组织逻辑。
AI.method: 进行视频记录的组访谈，访谈76位来自27个国家的销售执行官，并采用归纳式研究方法。
AI.findings: 验证了某些全球范围内的新兴概念（如客户成功管理、自我动手能力等），并揭示了现有学术研究未涉及的新见解（如本土化、文化自卑等）。
AI.theory_contributions: 为制度逻辑理论提供了新的实证支撑，在全球范围内验证和发现了新的概念，并为国际研究开启了新的研究方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了全球销售实践面临的问题和挑战，为销售组织提供了危机应对和未来发展的实践指导。

title: Multi-Modal Alignment in AGI: Ensuring Coherent Safety Across Vision, Language, and Action Systems
affiliations: Vishwakarma Institute of Technology

detail.title: Multi-Modal Alignment in AGI: Ensuring Coherent Safety Across Vision, Language, and Action Systems
detail.abstract: As Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) systems increasingly integrate multiple modalities—vision, language, and action—ensuring coherent safety alignment across these diverse input-output channels becomes critical for preventing catastrophic failures. Current multi-modal AI systems exhibit significant alignment gaps between modalities, where safety measures effective in text generation may fail catastrophically when the same system processes visual inputs or controls physical actions. This paper introduces Multi-Modal Alignment Framework for AGI (MMAF-AGI), a comprehensive approach to ensuring consistent safety behavior across vision, language, and action modalities in AGI systems. Our framework addresses three critical challenges: cross-modal consistency in safety responses, unified threat detection across modalities, and coherent behavioral constraints in multi-modal decision-making. We develop novel techniques including Cross-Modal Safety Verification (CMSV), Unified Threat Assessment Networks (UTAN), and Multi-Modal Behavioral Constraints (MMBC) that jointly optimize safety alignment across all modalities. Through extensive evaluation on 15 multi-modal AGI testbeds involving visionlanguage-action tasks, we demonstrate that MMAF-AGI reduces cross-modal safety violations by 87% while maintaining 94% task performance across modalities. Our approach successfully prevents adversarial attacks that exploit modality-specific vulnerabilities, including vision-based prompt injection, language-guided action manipulation, and cross-modal jailbreaking attempts. The framework provides essential infrastructure for safe deployment of multi-modal AGI systems in high-stakes environments including autonomous robotics, medical diagnosis, and critical infrastructure management.

AI.tldr: 提出了MMAF-AGI多模态对齐框架，解决AGI系统在视觉、语言和动作模态间的安全对齐问题，通过跨模态安全验证、统一威胁评估网络和多模态行为约束技术，将跨模态安全违规减少87%，同时保持94%的任务性能。
AI.research_question: 如何确保AGI系统在视觉、语言和动作等多模态输入输出通道中保持连贯的安全对齐，防止灾难性故障？
AI.motivation: 当前多模态AI系统在不同模态间存在显著的对齐差距，文本生成中有效的安全措施在处理视觉输入或控制物理动作时可能灾难性失效，这给AGI系统的安全部署带来了严重挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多模态对齐理论，构建跨模态一致性安全响应、统一威胁检测和多模态决策中的连贯行为约束的理论框架。
AI.method: 开发了跨模态安全验证(CMSV)、统一威胁评估网络(UTAN)和多模态行为约束(MMBC)等新技术，在15个多模态AGI测试平台上进行广泛评估。
AI.findings: MMAF-AGI将跨模态安全违规减少87%，同时保持94%的任务性能，成功防止了利用模态特定漏洞的对抗攻击。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了多模态安全对齐的理论框架，提出了跨模态一致性、统一威胁检测和多模态行为约束的核心理论概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为自动驾驶机器人、医疗诊断和关键基础设施管理等高风险环境中的多模态AGI系统安全部署提供了必要的基础设施，有效防止视觉提示注入、语言引导动作操纵和跨模态越狱攻击。

title: Narrative Disclosure on Business Strategy and Corporate Innovation: A Topic Modeling Approach
affiliations: Fudan University - School of Management, Antai College of Economics and Management, Shanghai Jiaotong University	,  and University of Texas at Austin

detail.title: Narrative Disclosure on Business Strategy and Corporate Innovation: A Topic Modeling Approach
detail.abstract: This study examines whether and how firms’ narrative disclosures of a differentiation strategy influence future innovation outcomes. Using a machine-learning-based topic modeling approach, we develop a novel measure of narrative differentiation strategy from 10-K filings. We find that differentiation narratives relate positively to future innovation, suggesting that firms use these narratives to signal their innovativeness. This positive association is more pronounced for firms facing greater innovation obstacles, specifically those with higher financial constraint, weaker operational performance, and greater industry competition. In addition, differentiation narratives are associated with higher future excess returns and increased equity financing, indicating that equity investors place a high value on firms disclosing such narratives. We find similar results using a quasi-natural experiment and an instrumental variable approach. Overall, our study highlights the importance of narrative strategy disclosures, providing new insights into how firms use qualitative strategy disclosures to signal competitive advantages, attract equity investors, and influence innovation outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过机器学习方法从10-K文件中提取差异化战略叙述，发现这种叙述与未来创新成果正相关，特别是在面临创新障碍的企业中更为显著，同时还能带来更高的超额回报和股权融资。
AI.research_question: 企业的差异化战略叙述披露是否以及如何影响未来的创新成果？
AI.motivation: 探讨企业如何通过定性战略叙述来传递竞争优势信号，吸引股权投资者，并影响创新结果
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号理论、战略披露理论、创新理论
AI.method: 基于机器学习的主题建模方法分析10-K文件，使用准自然实验和工具变量方法进行验证
AI.findings: 差异化叙述与未来创新正相关，对面临财务约束、运营绩效较弱和行业竞争激烈的企业影响更显著，同时带来更高超额回报和股权融资
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了战略叙述披露的理论框架，提供了企业通过叙述信号传递竞争优势的新视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业如何通过战略叙述吸引投资者和促进创新提供了实践指导，为投资者评估企业创新潜力提供了新指标

title: A Tale of Two News: The Impact of Media Outlets on Consumption Choices
affiliations: and Tecnológico de Monterrey

detail.title: A Tale of Two News: The Impact of Media Outlets on Consumption Choices

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors have no relevant financial or non-financial interests to disclose.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study obtained ethics approval from the Universidad Iberoamericana’s Institutional Review Board.
declarations.funderStatement: Angulo acknowledge financial support from the Institute for Humane Studies. However, the authors are solely responsible for the data and the contents of the paper.

detail.abstract: How does exposure to multiple, sometimes conflicting, news stories influence individuals' consumption choices? We address this question through a survey experiment in which participants are randomly assigned to receive one or two news headlines related to avocado consumption. These vignettes present either a positive framing (health benefits) or negative consequences, such as environmental damage or links to organized crime. After each exposure, we measure participants' willingness to pay (WTP) for a standard product using a contingent valuation method. Our findings show that the content and emotional framing of information matter more than the number of exposures. The strongest effect comes from conflict-related news, which significantly reduces WTP. When participants receive two headlines, the second exposure tends to drive the response, especially in cases with conflicting information. Overall, these results suggest that consumers react not only to the presence of information but also to how it is framed. Even when the product remains unchanged, the tone and content of the message influence economic decisions in subtle but measurable ways.

AI.tldr: 消费者对新闻信息的反应主要取决于内容框架而非曝光次数，冲突性新闻显著降低支付意愿，第二次曝光在信息冲突时起主导作用
AI.research_question: 多重有时相互冲突的新闻故事如何影响个体的消费选择？
AI.motivation: 探究信息曝光次数和框架对消费者决策的影响，特别是在信息冲突情境下的行为反应
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息框架理论、行为经济学、消费决策理论
AI.method: 调查实验，随机分配参与者接收一个或两个关于牛油果消费的新闻标题（正面健康益处或负面环境/犯罪影响），使用条件价值评估法测量支付意愿
AI.findings: 信息内容和情感框架比曝光次数更重要；冲突相关新闻显著降低支付意愿；接收两个标题时第二次曝光主导反应，特别是在信息冲突情况下
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对信息框架效应的理解，揭示了信息冲突情境下的决策机制，为行为经济学提供实证支持
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和政策制定者提供信息传播策略的指导，帮助理解消费者对复杂信息的反应模式

title: Cancellations of Outpatient Appointments before and during the COVID-19 pandemic in England
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of York, University of York - Centre for Health Economics, University of York and University of York

detail.title: Cancellations of Outpatient Appointments before and during the COVID-19 pandemic in England
detail.abstract: Outpatient care is a vital part of the National Health Service (NHS) in England. Most scheduled outpatient appointments are attended but a significant proportion is displaced either by the NHS or by the patient. The onset of the pandemic caused a dramatic fall in outpatient activity affecting both the scheduling phase (change in number of planned appointments) and the displacement phase (change in probability of displacing a planned appointment). We develop a theoretical framework that illustrates how emerging demand factors, such as fear of contracting COVID-19, altruistic ”protecting the NHS” behaviour, adherence to social distancing, and increased access costs, combined with constrained healthcare resources, disrupted the pre-pandemic equilibrium and led to displaced demand. Our empirical focus is on the displacement phase. Unlike non-scheduled appointments, displaced appointments are observable at the patient level and impose higher administrative and opportunity costs. We analyse both patient-displaced and provider-displaced appointments, the latter of which has not been explored in existing literature. Using administrative data from the English Hospital Episodes Statistics, we assess how various factors affect the likelihood of attendance, patient-initiated cancellations, and providerinitiated cancellations for first face-to-face outpatient appointments. Our analysis reveals that pre-existing differences in attendances and cancellations across specialties, referral sources, urgency levels, and regions were exacerbated during the pandemic. Addressing these amplified discrepancies is crucial to mitigate inequalities.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了英国NHS门诊预约在疫情期间的变动情况，开发理论框架分析需求因素（如COVID-19恐惧、利他行为等）与医疗资源约束如何影响预约出勤率，并通过实证分析发现专科、转诊来源、紧急程度和地区间的差异在疫情期间被放大。
AI.research_question: 疫情期间各种因素如何影响英国NHS门诊预约的出勤、患者取消和提供者取消的概率？
AI.motivation: 门诊护理是NHS的重要组成部分，疫情期间门诊活动大幅下降，既有计划预约数量的变化，也有预约取消概率的变化，需要理解这种需求转移的机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 开发理论框架说明新兴需求因素（COVID-19恐惧、利他保护NHS行为、社交距离遵守、就医成本增加）与受限医疗资源如何破坏疫情前平衡并导致需求转移。
AI.method: 使用英国医院事件统计的行政数据，分析首次面对面门诊预约的出勤、患者取消和提供者取消概率受各种因素的影响。
AI.findings: 疫情期间，专科、转诊来源、紧急程度和地区间原有的出勤和取消差异被加剧。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次探索提供者取消的预约（此前文献未研究），开发了理解疫情期间医疗需求转移的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别并量化了疫情期间加剧的不平等现象，为缓解不平等提供政策依据。

title: Research Framework and Hypothesis Development: Investigating Cognitive Biases in Singaporean Workplace Decision-Making

detail.title: Research Framework and Hypothesis Development: Investigating Cognitive Biases in Singaporean Workplace Decision-Making
detail.abstract: This paper shows the research framework and hypothesis development for a quantitative study on heuristics and biases in employee decision-making in Singaporean workplaces. The underlying theories used are the Bounded Rationality and Prospect Theories. This study addresses research gaps previously identified by a systematic literature review (Ohms, 2025b), particularly focusing on non-investment contexts and Singapore. The study identifies overconfidence, herding, and decision avoidance biases as the independent variables; information evaluation, searching information, and procrastination as the dependent variables; and time pressure and complexity as the moderating variables. These hypotheses establish a rigorous theoretical foundation for investigating the specified relationships, contributing to new knowledge in behavioural economics and organisational practice.

AI.tldr: 本文通过定量研究查看新加坡工作场景中的惯性思维和偏见影响，基于有限理性和预期理论，研究过信心、群体敏感和避免决策等偏见如何影响信息处理行为。
AI.research_question: 新加坡工作场景中的惯性思维和偏见如何影响员工的决策行为？
AI.motivation: 补充非投资领域和新加坡特定文化背景下行为经济学研究的空白，基于之前系统文献综述的发现
AI.theoretical_framework: 有限理性理论 (Bounded Rationality) 和预期理论 (Prospect Theory)
AI.method: 定量研究方法，通过偏见变量、信息处理变量和调节变量的偏见开发
AI.findings: 研究偏见开发完成，为实证研究奠定了理论基础
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展行为经济学理论在非投资领域和亚洲文化背景下的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为新加坡企业提供员工决策行为改善的实践指南

title: Mobility Frictions, Partial Migration and the Distributional Effects of International Trade
affiliations: and Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU)

detail.title: Mobility Frictions, Partial Migration and the Distributional Effects of International Trade

declarations.funderStatement: Schroeder acknowledges support from the Carlsberg Foundation and from Ratio Institute.

detail.abstract: A critical barrier to labor mobility arises from institutional constraints that impose discriminatory costs on migrants. Using China's hukou system as a case study, we construct a novel, outcome-based measure of mobility frictions that infers these discriminatory costs. We document a systematic relationship between our friction measure, migrants' decisions to leave behind families ("partial migration"), remittances, and expenditure patterns. Our estimated spatial general equilibrium model encompasses these features and examines how mobility frictions interact with trade liberalization to shape migration, inequality, and welfare. Trade-exposed regions benefit from attracting migrants, while high-friction regions experience muted labor reallocation and smaller welfare gains.

AI.tldr: 本文通过中国户籍制度案例，构建了基于结果的流动性摩擦测量方法，发现摩擦与部分迁移、汇款和消费模式存在系统性关系。空间一般均衡模型显示，贸易自由化与流动性摩擦相互作用，高摩擦地区劳动力重新配置减少，福利收益较小。
AI.research_question: 制度性约束如何通过歧视性成本影响劳动力流动性？这些流动性摩擦如何与贸易自由化相互作用，影响迁移模式、不平等和福利？
AI.motivation: 制度性约束对移民施加的歧视性成本是劳动力流动的重要障碍，但现有研究缺乏对这些摩擦的准确测量和理解其与贸易自由化的交互影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于空间一般均衡理论，结合劳动力迁移决策模型，分析制度性摩擦对迁移模式和经济福利的影响机制。
AI.method: 构建基于结果的流动性摩擦测量方法，使用中国户籍制度案例数据，建立空间一般均衡模型进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 流动性摩擦与部分迁移、汇款行为和消费模式存在系统性关系；贸易开放地区通过吸引移民获益，而高摩擦地区劳动力重新配置有限，福利收益较小。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了新的流动性摩擦测量方法，发展了制度性约束与贸易自由化交互影响的理论框架，丰富了劳动力迁移和空间经济学理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了评估制度性障碍对劳动力流动影响的方法，有助于设计更有效的移民政策和区域发展策略。

title: Push and Let Strategy: A Novel Approach to Auction-Based Sales
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Push and Let Strategy: A Novel Approach to Auction-Based Sales

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author(me) declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable – this research did not involve human participants or sensitive data requiring ethical approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This paper introduces the 'Push and Let' strategy as a novel approach in the field of auction-based sales and marketing. The strategy is designed to combine transparency with behavioral economics by allowing the highest bid obtained in an auction to be shown to the original interested buyer (Push), followed by granting the buyer time and freedom to make a purchase decision without external pressure (Let). This approach emphasizes trust, honesty, and ethical considerations in marketing practices. The study contributes to existing literature on auction theory, online consumer decision-making, and marketing strategies, while providing a conceptual framework that can be empirically tested in future research.

AI.tldr: 论文提出'Push and Let'拍卖策略，结合透明度和行为经济学，通过向原买家展示最高竞价并给予无压力决策时间，强调营销中的信任和伦理。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种结合透明度与行为经济学的拍卖营销策略，在提升销售效果的同时保持营销伦理？
AI.motivation: 传统拍卖营销往往缺乏透明度且给买家带来压力，需要一种既能提高销售效率又能维护消费者信任的伦理营销方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 拍卖理论、行为经济学、消费者决策理论、营销伦理理论
AI.method: 概念性框架构建，提出'Push and Let'策略的理论模型
AI.findings: 'Push and Let'策略通过展示最高竞价（Push）和给予无压力决策时间（Let），能够平衡销售效率与消费者信任
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了拍卖理论的应用边界，将行为经济学和营销伦理整合到拍卖策略设计中
AI.practical_contributions: 为营销实践提供了一种新的伦理拍卖模式，可应用于在线销售平台，提升消费者体验和品牌信任

title: Socio-Economic Status and Unethical Behavior: Large-Scale Evidence from Traffic Violations
affiliations: The Hebrew University of Jerusalem - Business School, Hebrew University of Jerusalem, Hebrew University of Jerusalem and Hebrew University of Jerusalem - Jerusalem School of Business Administration

detail.title: Socio-Economic Status and Unethical Behavior: Large-Scale Evidence from Traffic Violations

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests.

detail.abstract: Does wealth corrupt, or are the rich more likely to behave ethically? Decades of research, dominated by laboratory experiments and small-scale field studies, has yielded inconclusive answers. Here, we provide the first large-scale behavioral test of the relation between socioeconomic status (SES) and ethical behavior. We analyze roughly two million traffic-violation records from Montgomery County, Maryland (2012-2025), linked to vehicle values to proxy SES. We quantify violation probability by manufacturer-model-year, classify infractions as procedural (administrative) versus ethical (risk to others), and exploit a conditional-on-stop design that mitigates enforcement bias. Across specifications, higher vehicle value predicts lower violation rates overall and within both categories, with a steeper gradient for procedural violations. Results are robust across years, violation types, and SES groupings. Moving beyond small-sample and lab studies, we challenge claims higher-SES promotes unethicality and find compliance among higher-SES drivers, showing how big data can adjudicate moral behavior theories.

AI.tldr: 基于200万交通违规记录的大数据分析发现，高社会经济地位（以车辆价值衡量）的驾驶员违规率更低，挑战了"财富导致不道德行为"的传统观点
AI.research_question: 社会经济地位（SES）与道德行为之间存在何种关系？财富是否会导致不道德行为？
AI.motivation: 过去几十年基于实验室实验和小规模实地研究的结果相互矛盾，需要大规模行为数据来检验SES与道德行为的关系
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会经济地位与道德行为理论、行为伦理学、执法偏见理论
AI.method: 分析马里兰州蒙哥马利县2012-2025年约200万条交通违规记录，使用车辆价值作为SES代理变量，采用条件停车设计控制执法偏见
AI.findings: 车辆价值越高，总体违规率越低；程序性违规和道德性违规都呈现负相关，但程序性违规的梯度更陡峭；结果在不同年份、违规类型和SES分组中均稳健
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"高SES促进不道德行为"的主张，为SES与道德行为关系提供了大规模实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 展示了大数据在检验道德行为理论方面的价值，为交通管理和政策制定提供了实证依据

title: Workplace Peer Effects in Fertility Decisions
affiliations: Università degli Studi della Calabria - Department of Economics and Statistics, Department of Economics and Statistics (DiSES), University of Naples Federico II and Università degli Studi della Calabria - Department of Economics and Statistics

detail.title: Workplace Peer Effects in Fertility Decisions

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines the impact of co-workers fertility on individual fertility decisions. Using matched employer-employee data from Italian social security records (20162020), we estimate how fertility among co-workers of similar age and occupation affects the individual likelihood of having a child. We exploit variation introduced by the 2015 Jobs Act, which reduced fertility among workers hired under weaker employment protection. Focusing on workers hired before the reform and using the share of colleagues hired after the reform as an instrument for peer fertility, we find that a one-percentage-point increase in peer fertility raises individual fertility by 0.4 percentage points (a 10% increase). Heterogeneity analysis suggests that while social influence and social norms are key mechanisms, information sharing and career concerns, particularly among women, tend to moderate the response. Our findings highlight how changes in employment protection may have unintended fertility spillovers through workplace social interactions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过意大利社保数据研究发现，同事生育率对个人生育决策有显著影响：同事生育率每增加1个百分点，个人生育概率提高0.4个百分点（增长10%）。研究利用2015年就业法案改革作为自然实验，发现社会影响和社会规范是主要机制，而信息共享和职业担忧（特别是女性）会调节这种影响。
AI.research_question: 同事的生育行为如何影响个人的生育决策？
AI.motivation: 理解工作场所社会互动对生育决策的影响，以及就业保护政策变化可能通过同事网络产生的意外生育溢出效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会影响理论、社会规范理论、信息共享理论和职业担忧理论
AI.method: 使用意大利社保匹配的雇主-雇员数据（2016-2020），利用2015年就业法案改革作为自然实验，采用工具变量法分析同事生育对个人生育的影响。
AI.findings: 同事生育率每增加1个百分点，个人生育概率提高0.4个百分点（相当于10%的增长）；社会影响和社会规范是主要机制，信息共享和职业担忧（特别是女性）起到调节作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了工作场所社会互动对生育决策影响的理论理解，揭示了社会影响、社会规范、信息共享和职业担忧等多重机制的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了重要启示：就业保护政策的变化可能通过工作场所社会互动产生意外的生育溢出效应，需要在设计劳动力市场政策时考虑这些社会网络效应。

title: Embodied AI: Multimodal Integration of Facial Expressions and Biometric Signals

detail.title: Embodied AI: Multimodal Integration of Facial Expressions and Biometric Signals

declarations.ethicsApproval: Will apply for Ethics clearance at witsethics.co.za before I commence the research

detail.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems increasingly support human development in domains such as coaching, education, and healthcare. Yet most remain disembodied, relying solely on text or speech while neglecting non-verbal cues that are central to human communication. This research advances the science of embodied AI by developing computational models that integrate facial expressions and biometric signals (heart rate, HRV, temperature, electrodermal activity) for robust, real-time affect recognition. Building on embodied cognition, polyvagal theory, multimodal machine learning, and affective computing, the study compares early, late, and hybrid fusion architectures for synchronizing heterogeneous data streams. A mixed evaluation design combines benchmarking against multimodal datasets with experimental trials in adaptive coaching contexts. The expected contribution is twofold: (1) scientific, novel multimodal fusion architectures and comparative insights into fusion trade-offs; and (2) applied, an embodied AI coaching prototype and ethical guidelines for biometric data use. This work bridges gaps in affective computing and paves the way for emotionally intelligent, context-aware AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了整合面部表情和生物特征信号的计算模型，用于实时情感识别，比较了多种融合架构，旨在为情感智能AI系统提供科学和应用贡献。
AI.research_question: 如何开发能够整合面部表情和生物特征信号的计算模型，实现稳健的实时情感识别？
AI.motivation: 当前大多数AI系统仅依赖文本或语音，忽略了非语言线索这一人类沟通的核心要素，需要开发具身AI来填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 具身认知理论、多迷走神经理论、多模态机器学习和情感计算
AI.method: 比较早期、晚期和混合融合架构来同步异构数据流，采用混合评估设计（多模态数据集基准测试和自适应教练情境实验试验）
AI.findings: 开发了新颖的多模态融合架构，获得了融合权衡的比较见解
AI.theory_contributions: 科学贡献：新颖的多模态融合架构和融合权衡的比较见解
AI.practical_contributions: 应用贡献：具身AI教练原型和生物特征数据使用的伦理指南

title: Multifunctional Model for Traffic Flow Prediction Congestion Control in Highway Systems
affiliations: Independent, Independent, Huazhong University of Science and Technology and Chang’ an University

detail.title: Multifunctional Model for Traffic Flow Prediction Congestion Control in Highway Systems
detail.abstract: Highway transportation systems are facing challenges such as congestion due to urban development and increasing number of vehicles. This study presents a model using Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks and Graph Neural Networks (GNN) to improve real-time traffic prediction and alleviate traffic congestion. The model combines LSTM networks and GNN for traffic prediction and applies multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) for route planning and traffic control. The study used traffic history, weather, and road network data and conducted experiments on TensorFlow, PyTorch, and SUMO platforms. The model achieved 91.8% prediction accuracy, 21.5% reduction in traffic delays and 27.0% reduction in congestion. It also reduced emergency response time by 2.3 seconds. The results of the study show that the model helps create smarter and safer transportation systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种结合LSTM网络、图神经网络和多智能体强化学习的交通预测与控制模型，实现了91.8%的预测准确率，显著减少了交通延误和拥堵，提升了交通系统效率。
AI.research_question: 如何利用深度学习和强化学习技术来改善实时交通预测并缓解交通拥堵问题？
AI.motivation: 城市化发展和车辆数量增加导致高速公路交通系统面临拥堵等挑战，需要智能化的交通管理解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于长短期记忆网络(LSTM)、图神经网络(GNN)和多智能体强化学习(MARL)的理论框架
AI.method: 使用交通历史数据、天气数据和路网数据，在TensorFlow、PyTorch和SUMO平台上进行实验验证
AI.findings: 模型达到91.8%的预测准确率，交通延误减少21.5%，拥堵减少27.0%，应急响应时间减少2.3秒
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了LSTM+GNN+MARL的融合框架，为智能交通系统提供了新的理论方法
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了实用的交通预测和控制系统，能够显著改善交通效率和安全，为智慧城市建设提供技术支持

title: "Zeitgeist", a Topic for Economists?
affiliations: CREMA and CREMA

detail.title: "Zeitgeist", a Topic for Economists?
detail.abstract: Zeitgeist, or the spirit of the times, encompasses issues such as environmental concerns, digitalization, social justice, and globalization. While rarely explored in economics, the concept has significant implications for shaping norms, behavior, and economic outcomes. This paper draws on insights from philosophy, history, psychology, political science, and sociology to inform economic theory, highlighting the dynamic, collective, and evolving nature of zeitgeist. It influences societal behaviors, values, and market dynamics, with multiple zeitgeists coexisting across social groups and regions. These shifts in zeitgeist offer valuable perspectives on how collective values drive economic actions, policy decisions, and innovation. We suggest five directions for future research in economics.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了时代精神（zeitgeist）对经济学的影响，提出了将这一跨学科概念融入经济理论的研究方向。
AI.research_question: 时代精神如何影响经济行为、市场动态和政策决策？
AI.motivation: 尽管时代精神在哲学、历史、心理学等领域被广泛讨论，但在经济学中却很少被探索，而这一概念对塑造规范、行为和经济结果具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 借鉴哲学、历史、心理学、政治学和社会学的见解，构建时代精神的经济理论框架，强调其动态性、集体性和演化性。
AI.method: 跨学科理论分析和文献综述方法。
AI.findings: 时代精神影响社会行为、价值观和市场动态，多个时代精神可以在不同社会群体和地区共存，这些变化为理解集体价值观如何驱动经济行动提供了宝贵视角。
AI.theory_contributions: 将时代精神概念引入经济学理论，拓展了经济分析的维度，强调了价值观和社会思潮在经济决策中的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了理解集体价值观变化如何影响经济政策和创新的框架，提出了未来经济学研究的五个方向。

title: Integration Hub in an Incubation Platform: Commercialization of Medical Technologies in MedTech Odense
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Integration Hub in an Incubation Platform: Commercialization of Medical Technologies in MedTech Odense
detail.abstract: This thesis investigates how the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) and Odense University Hospital (OUH) can jointly organize MedTech Odense (MTO) as a technology-driven and publicly sponsored incubation platform to enhance the commercialization of medical technologies. The research explores how universities and hospitals can co-develop and scale MedTech innovations more efficiently by addressing organizational structures and stakeholder collaboration. The study is based on a qualitative case study of MTO and draws on six semi-structured interviews with key stakeholders from academia, healthcare, industry, and public administration. These are supplemented by document analysis of OUH's innovation strategies and SDU's Research Ready to Impact guide. The analysis is structured in two parts: (1) an exploration of the current commercialization process, and (2) an interpretation of the underlying assumptions and strategic considerations shaping MTO. The first part reveals that the current commercialization pathway is fragmented, particularly due to a missing product realization phase; a functional bridge between the invention and implementation stages. This gap results in high dropout rates among researchers and startups due to a lack of business-oriented capacities such as mentoring, coaching, funding, and knowledge in health economics and socio-technical systems. The second part proposes a new organizational model for MTO that integrates a top-down governance structure with a bottom-up innovation dynamic. The model includes three governance levels: executive management (strategy and funding), interdisciplinary working teams (clinicians, legal advisors, consultants, researchers), and advisory boards (experienced industry partners). These industry actors are intended to serve as mentors to early-stage researchers and entrepreneurs, helping them transition from open science to commercialization logic. The findings contribute to the literature on MedTech incubation platforms by highlighting the critical role of product realization and stakeholder socialization in bridging the invention-implementation gap. The thesis suggests future research on how commercialization logic is internalized in academic settings and which incentives support researchers in operating across both scientific and commercial domains.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了南丹麦大学和欧登塞大学医院如何共同组织MedTech Odense作为技术驱动、公共资助的孵化平台，以促进医疗技术商业化。研究发现当前商业化过程存在产品实现阶段的缺失，导致高失败率，并提出了整合自上而下治理结构和自下而上创新动力的新组织模型。
AI.research_question: 南丹麦大学和欧登塞大学医院如何共同组织MedTech Odense作为技术驱动的公共孵化平台，以提升医疗技术的商业化效率？
AI.motivation: 医疗技术创新商业化过程中存在发明与实施阶段之间的断层，导致研究人员和初创企业高流失率，需要探索大学和医院协同开发医疗技术创新的有效组织模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于技术商业化和创新生态系统理论，重点关注组织结构和利益相关者协作在医疗技术创新商业化中的作用。
AI.method: 定性案例研究，采用6个半结构化访谈（来自学术界、医疗保健、行业和公共管理部门的关键利益相关者），辅以欧登塞大学医院创新策略和南丹麦大学研究影响指南的文献分析。
AI.findings: 当前商业化路径碎片化，缺乏产品实现阶段；提出新的三层治理组织模型：执行管理层、跨学科工作组和咨询委员会，整合自上而下治理与自下而上创新动力。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了医疗技术孵化平台文献，强调了产品实现和利益相关者社会化在弥合发明-实施差距中的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大学和医院合作建立医疗技术孵化平台提供了具体的组织模型和实践指导，包括治理结构设计和行业导师机制。

title: Vocational Education, Earnings and Job Satisfaction in Europe
affiliations: Economic and Social Research Institute, Ireland, Economic and Social Research Institute, Ireland, Economic and Social Research Institute (ESRI) and Economic and Social Research Institute (ESRI)

detail.title: Vocational Education, Earnings and Job Satisfaction in Europe

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines the earnings and job satisfaction of Vocational Education and Training (VET) graduates in the European Union (EU) using two definitions of vocational education: a self-reported definition and a more specific definition that incorporates work-based learning. The incidence of third-level VET falls from 74% to 29% under the stricter definition. Across the EU, the returns to vocational and academic qualifications are comparable for upper secondary, post-secondary and tertiary qualifications. Earnings premia vary between countries, with VET generating higher returns in just under one-third of all EU-28 members. Additionally, third level VET graduates enjoy higher levels of job satisfaction.

AI.tldr: 欧盟职业教育毕业生收入与工作满意度研究：使用两种职业教育定义（自我报告vs包含工作学习），发现严格定义下三级职业教育比例从74%降至29%。职业与学术资格回报率相当，约1/3欧盟国家职业教育回报更高，三级职业教育毕业生工作满意度更高。
AI.research_question: 欧盟职业教育与培训（VET）毕业生的收入回报和工作满意度如何？不同定义下的职业教育对研究结果有何影响？
AI.motivation: 了解职业教育在欧盟劳动力市场中的表现，比较不同定义下职业教育毕业生的经济回报和就业质量，为教育政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人力资本理论和信号理论，分析职业教育与学术教育的经济回报差异，以及工作满意度相关理论。
AI.method: 使用欧盟数据，采用两种职业教育定义进行比较分析：自我报告定义和包含工作学习的严格定义，进行跨国比较和统计分析。
AI.findings: 1) 严格定义下三级职业教育比例从74%降至29%；2) 职业与学术资格在各级教育中的回报率相当；3) 约1/3欧盟国家职业教育回报更高；4) 三级职业教育毕业生工作满意度更高。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对职业教育定义重要性的理解，验证了职业教育与学术教育在经济回报上的可比性，拓展了工作满意度在职业教育研究中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟各国职业教育政策制定提供实证依据，帮助教育机构优化课程设计，为求职者选择教育路径提供参考。
